title.zh: 卷155 志一百三十 邦交三 法兰西
title.raw: 卷155 志一百三十 邦交三 法兰西

sentences.zh: 法蘭西一名佛郎機，在歐羅巴之西。

translations.literal: Falanxi [France], also called Folangji, lies in the western part of Europe.
translations.idiomatic: France, also known by the older name Folangji, lies in the western part of Europe.

sentences.zh: 清來廣東互巿，廣東總督佟養甲疏言：「佛郎機國人寓居濠境澳門，與粵商互巿，仍禁深入省會。」

translations.literal: When the Qing came to Guangdong for mutual trade, Guangdong Governor-General Tong Yangjia memorialized: 'Nationals of Folangji reside at Macao in the Qiaojing district and trade with Cantonese merchants, yet they are still forbidden to penetrate deep into the provincial capital.'
translations.idiomatic: When the Qing opened trade at Guangdong, Governor-General Tong Yangjia memorialized: "Folangji nationals live at Macao in the Qiaojing quarter, trade with Cantonese merchants, and are still barred from penetrating the provincial capital."

sentences.zh: 法人素崇天主教，康熙以來，屢禁漢人入教。

translations.literal: The French have long revered Catholicism; since the Kangxi reign, Chinese have repeatedly been forbidden to join the church.
translations.idiomatic: The French had long been devoted to Catholicism, and since the Kangxi reign the court had repeatedly forbidden Chinese to take the faith.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年，法商赴粵，詣總督署，請弛漢人習教之禁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang, French merchants went to Guangdong, called at the governor-general's yamen, and requested the lifting of the ban on Chinese taking up the faith.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang, French merchants went to Guangdong, called at the governor-general's yamen, and asked that the ban on Chinese joining the church be lifted.

sentences.zh: 總督耆英據以入告，許之開堂傳教，仍限於海口，禁入內地。

translations.literal: Governor-General Qiying memorialized accordingly; permission was granted to open churches for preaching, still limited to treaty ports and forbidden in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Qiying memorialized accordingly; the court allowed churches to open for preaching, but only at treaty ports and not in the interior.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年十二月，有法輪船一駛入長江，未幾解纜去。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Xianfeng, one French steamship entered the Yangtze; before long it weighed anchor and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year of Xianfeng, a French steamship entered the Yangtze and soon weighed anchor and left.

sentences.zh: 而法與英、美又欲變通成約，廣東總督葉名琛以換約未屆期，拒之。

translations.literal: But France together with Britain and the United States again sought to revise the established treaty; Guangdong Governor-General Ye Mingchen, holding that the treaty exchange was not yet due, refused.
translations.idiomatic: France, Britain, and the United States then sought to revise the treaties again; Guangdong Governor-General Ye Mingchen refused, holding that the exchange date had not yet arrived.

sentences.zh: 遂偕英、美逕赴天津，要求如英、美，並請釋陝西傳教人，長蘆鹽政崇綸等以聞。

translations.literal: They then went with Britain and the United States straight to Tianjin, demanding terms equal to those of Britain and the United States, and also requesting the release of missionaries in Shaanxi; Changlu salt commissioner Chonglun and others reported this.
translations.idiomatic: They then went with Britain and the United States straight to Tianjin, demanding terms equal to Britain's and America's and also asking for the release of missionaries in Shaanxi; Changlu salt commissioner Chonglun and others reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 上以定例五口通商外，不許外人擅入內地，何以陝西盩厔縣有法人傳教？

translations.literal: The emperor said: Apart from the five treaty ports fixed by regulation, foreigners are not permitted to enter the interior at will—how is it that French missionaries are preaching in Zhouzhi County, Shaanxi?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked: Apart from the five treaty ports fixed by regulation, foreigners may not enter the interior at will—how then are French missionaries preaching in Zhouzhi County, Shaanxi?

sentences.zh: 飭令詳查，並嚴詞拒之，乃去。

translations.literal: He ordered a detailed investigation and sternly refused them, whereupon they departed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered a full investigation and refused them in stern terms, whereupon they departed.

sentences.zh: 時粵賊踞上海，築砲堤防禦，吉爾杭阿因向法提督辣厄爾告以「賊築砲堤，爾國領事署首當其衝，應速遷以免受傷。」

translations.literal: At the time Guangdong rebels held Shanghai and built gun batteries for defense; Jierhang'a therefore told French Admiral Lagrenée: "The rebels are building gun batteries, and your consulate will be the first in their line of fire—you should move quickly to avoid harm."
translations.idiomatic: At the time Guangdong rebels held Shanghai and built gun batteries for defense; Jierhang'a therefore told French Admiral Lagrenée: "The rebels are building gun batteries, and your consulate will bear the brunt—you should move quickly to avoid harm."

sentences.zh: 辣厄爾立毀其堤，並砲擊賊。

translations.literal: Lagrenée immediately destroyed the batteries and shelled the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Lagrenée immediately destroyed the batteries and shelled the rebels.

sentences.zh: 事聞，獎之。

translations.literal: When word reached court, he was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court, he was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 六年六月，英、美各國求換約，法公使顧思照會兩廣總督葉名琛，援約與英、美一體，力阻不從。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the sixth year, Britain, the United States, and other countries sought treaty revision; French minister Berthemy addressed a note to Liang-Guang Governor-General Ye Mingchen, citing the treaty and claiming parity with Britain and the United States, but Ye firmly obstructed and would not comply.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the sixth year Britain, the United States, and other countries sought treaty revision; French minister Berthemy addressed a note to Liang-Guang Governor-General Ye Mingchen, citing parity with Britain and America, but Ye firmly refused.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月二十一日，英人結法公使噶曆為援，襲入廣東省城，擄名琛以去。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of the twelfth month of the seventh year, the English, with French minister Gros as ally, stormed Guangzhou city and carried Mingchen away.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first day of the twelfth month of the seventh year the British, with French minister Gros as ally, stormed Guangzhou and carried Ye Mingchen away.

sentences.zh: 先是法人謂有人殺其說書老人，向名琛索犯，限三日交出，並要求五事：一，入城；

translations.literal: Earlier the French had claimed someone had killed their sermon reader, demanded the culprit from Mingchen with a three-day deadline for surrender, and put forward five demands: first, entry into the city;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the French had claimed someone had killed their sermon reader, demanded the culprit from Ye Mingchen within three days, and put forward five demands: first, entry into the city;

sentences.zh: 二，索河南地；

translations.literal: second, demand land south of the river;
translations.idiomatic: second, land south of the Pearl River;

sentences.zh: 三，求改章程；

translations.literal: third, seek revision of the regulations;
translations.idiomatic: third, revision of the commercial regulations;

sentences.zh: 四，索補兵費；

translations.literal: fourth, demand military indemnity;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, military indemnity;

sentences.zh: 五，求通商。

translations.literal: fifth, seek trade.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, trade.

sentences.zh: 限日答覆。

translations.literal: A deadline was set for reply.
translations.idiomatic: A deadline was set for reply.

sentences.zh: 名琛回牒許通商，餘皆不許，而又不設備，遂至被擄。

translations.literal: Mingchen replied by memorandum granting trade but refusing all else, yet made no preparations, and so was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Mingchen replied by memorandum granting trade but refusing everything else, yet made no preparations, and so was captured.

sentences.zh: 英、法連檣赴天津，美、俄亦相繼至，各有所求。

translations.literal: Britain and France sailed in joint fleet to Tianjin; the United States and Russia also arrived in succession, each with its own demands.
translations.idiomatic: Britain and France sailed in joint fleet to Tianjin; the United States and Russia also arrived in succession, each pressing its own demands.

sentences.zh: 法人又欲推廣商埠，任意傳教，遣公使駐京，入內地買絲茶，並請查辦廣西西林縣殺馬神父案，皆不許。

translations.literal: The French also wished to expand treaty ports, preach freely, dispatch ministers to reside in the capital, enter the interior to buy silk and tea, and requested investigation of the killing of Father Chapdelaine in Xilin County, Guangxi—all were refused.
translations.idiomatic: The French also sought to expand treaty ports, preach freely, station ministers in the capital, enter the interior to buy silk and tea, and demanded investigation of the killing of Father Chapdelaine in Xilin County, Guangxi—all were refused.

sentences.zh: 八年三月，法與英人攻踞海口砲台，進逼天津。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eighth year, France with Britain attacked and seized the Dagu forts and pressed toward Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the eighth year France and Britain attacked and seized the Dagu forts and pressed toward Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 於是命大學士桂良、吏部尚書花沙納往議，徇所請。

translations.literal: Thereupon Grand Secretary Gui Liang and Minister of Personnel Hua Shana were ordered to go and negotiate, yielding to the requests.
translations.idiomatic: The court then ordered Grand Secretary Gui Liang and Minister of Personnel Hua Shana to negotiate and yield to the requests.

sentences.zh: 遂於五月定約，法得通商、傳教及兵費，幾與英等。

translations.literal: Thus in the fifth month a treaty was concluded; France obtained trade, missionary rights, and military indemnity, nearly on a par with Britain.
translations.idiomatic: A treaty was concluded in the fifth month; France obtained trade, missionary rights, and military indemnity, nearly on a par with Britain.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，法公使布林布隆以進京換約為名，隨英公使普魯斯赴天津，拒不納，致傷敗數百人，折回上海，聲言調兵復仇。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year, French minister Bourboulon, under pretext of going to Beijing to exchange treaties, accompanied British minister Bruce to Tianjin; when refused admission, several hundred were wounded in the fighting; they turned back to Shanghai and declared they would summon troops for revenge.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year, French minister Bourboulon, claiming he was going to Beijing to exchange treaties, accompanied British minister Bruce to Tianjin; when the Chinese refused them entry, several hundred men were wounded; they withdrew to Shanghai and threatened to bring up troops for revenge.

sentences.zh: 未幾，法人復北駛，分擾登、青等處。

translations.literal: Before long, the French again sailed north, raiding in separate forces at Dengzhou, Qingzhou, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the French sailed north again and raided Dengzhou, Qingzhou, and other places in separate detachments.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，隨英來攻，連陷新河、唐兒沽北岸砲台，遂入天津。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, they came with the British to attack, successively capturing the forts on the north bank at Xinhe and Tang'ergu, and then entered Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year they came with the British, took the north-bank forts at Xinhe and Tang'ergu in succession, and entered Tianjin.

sentences.zh: 先是遣西寧辦事大臣文俊、武備院卿恆祺往議，不報。

translations.literal: Previously the court had sent Xining commissioner Wen Jun and Director of the Armory Heng Qi to negotiate, but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: The court had earlier sent Xining commissioner Wen Jun and Director of the Armory Heng Qi to negotiate, but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 至是，又遣桂良、恆福為欽差大臣，往津會議，冀緩師，而法與英益恣要求。

translations.literal: At this juncture, Gui Liang and Heng Fu were again sent as imperial commissioners to Tianjin to confer, hoping to slow the advance of the armies; but France and Britain grew ever more unrestrained in their demands.
translations.idiomatic: The court now sent Gui Liang and Heng Fu as imperial commissioners to Tianjin in the hope of slowing the armies, but France and Britain pressed their demands ever harder.

sentences.zh: 初，津約原許補法軍費二百萬，英四百萬。

translations.literal: Initially the Tianjin treaty had promised indemnities of two million for French military expenses and four million for Britain.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjin treaty had originally allowed two million taels in military indemnity to France and four million to Britain.

sentences.zh: 至是，英索倍加，法欲照英數，復要求天津通商、京師長駐。

translations.literal: Now Britain demanded double; France wished to match Britain's figure and additionally demanded trade at Tianjin and a permanent residence in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Britain now demanded double that sum; France wanted the same amount as Britain and also demanded trade at Tianjin and a permanent legation in the capital.

sentences.zh: 朝旨不許。

translations.literal: The imperial decree did not grant permission.
translations.idiomatic: The throne refused.

sentences.zh: 乃隨英督兵北上，進逼通州，京師戒嚴。

translations.literal: They then followed Britain in moving troops north, pressing on Tongzhou, and Beijing was placed under martial alert.
translations.idiomatic: They then followed Britain north with troops, pressed on Tongzhou, and Beijing was placed under martial law.

sentences.zh: 怡親王載垣等再議和，不就。

translations.literal: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others negotiated peace again, but without success.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yi Zaiyuan and others tried to negotiate peace again, but failed.

sentences.zh: 進薄京師。

translations.literal: They advanced close to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: They drew up close to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 八月，恭親王奕訢留守，再議和。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Prince Gong Yixin remained to hold the capital and negotiate peace again.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Prince Gong Yixin remained in the capital and opened peace talks again.

sentences.zh: 九月，和議成，所得通商、軍費、權利與英等，而傳教、建堂初無限制。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the peace talks concluded; what was obtained in trade, military indemnity, and rights equaled Britain's, while missionary activity and building churches were at first unrestricted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month peace was concluded; France gained trade, indemnity, and privileges equal to Britain's, while missionary work and church building were at first left unrestricted.

sentences.zh: 十月，始定傳教之人須薙須服中國衣冠，其入內地，預領中、法合同護照，向所過地方官鈐印，以為信據。

translations.literal: In the tenth month it was first fixed that missionaries must shave the head and wear Chinese dress; those entering the interior must beforehand obtain Sino-French joint passports and have them stamped by local officials along the route as credentials.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month it was first ruled that missionaries must shave the head and wear Chinese dress; those entering the interior had to obtain joint Sino-French passports in advance and have them stamped by officials along the route as proof of identity.

sentences.zh: 法人以江南為新許商埠，欲早通商，請助剿粵賊，不許。

translations.literal: The French, with Jiangnan as a newly permitted trading port, wished to open trade early and requested assistance in suppressing the Guangdong rebels; this was not allowed.
translations.idiomatic: With Jiangnan newly opened as a treaty port, the French wished to trade there at once and asked to help suppress the Guangdong rebels; the request was refused.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，法公使布林布隆偕英使普魯斯由津如京，此為各國公使駐京之始。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eleventh year, French minister Bourboulon together with British minister Bruce went from Tianjin to Beijing—this was the beginning of foreign ministers residing in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eleventh year French minister Bourboulon and British minister Bruce went from Tianjin to Beijing—marking the beginning of permanent foreign legations in the capital.

sentences.zh: 先是條約有還清軍費始行退出廣東省城之議。

translations.literal: Previously the treaty had provided that Guangzhou city would be evacuated only after military expenses were fully paid.
translations.idiomatic: The treaty had earlier stipulated that Guangzhou would not be evacuated until military indemnities were fully paid.

sentences.zh: 至是，法人哥士耆來言，原先撤兵退出粵城，並求廣東籓署賃作領事署，又索還京城及各省天主堂舊基，均許之。

translations.literal: At this time the Frenchman Gros came to say that troops would first be withdrawn from Guangzhou, and also requested that the Guangdong provincial office rent space for a consulate, and sought return of old Catholic church sites in the capital and each province—all were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Frenchman Gros said troops would first be withdrawn from Guangzhou, asked that the Guangdong provincial yamen rent quarters for a consulate, and sought the return of old Catholic church sites in the capital and the provinces—all were granted.

sentences.zh: 九月，交還廣東省城。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Guangzhou city was returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Guangzhou was handed back.

sentences.zh: 同治元年正月，粵賊陷蘇、松、常、太等郡，朝議募洋將助剿，法人與焉。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Tongzhi, Guangdong rebels captured the prefectures of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taicang, and others; court deliberated recruiting foreign generals to assist suppression, and the French participated.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Tongzhi, Guangdong rebels captured Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Taicang, and other prefectures; the court debated recruiting foreign officers to help suppress them, and the French took part.

sentences.zh: 是年，貴州提督田興恕殺教民，毀天主堂，法使哥士耆以為言，朝廷命崇實、駱秉章、勞崇光及張亮基入黔查辦，久不決。

translations.literal: That year, Guizhou provincial commander Tian Xingyu killed converts and destroyed a Catholic church; French minister Gros protested; the court ordered Chong Shi, Luo Bingzhang, Lao Chongguang, and Zhang Liangji into Guizhou to investigate, but no settlement was reached for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: That year Guizhou provincial commander Tian Xingyu killed converts and destroyed a Catholic church; French minister Gros protested, and the court ordered Chong Shi, Luo Bingzhang, Lao Chongguang, and Zhang Liangji into Guizhou to investigate, but no settlement was reached for a long time.

sentences.zh: 會哥士耆回國，新公使柏爾德密至，始允照中律擬結。

translations.literal: When Gros returned home and the new minister de Bellonet arrived, agreement was finally reached to settle according to Chinese law.
translations.idiomatic: When Gros returned home and the new minister de Bellonet arrived, the parties finally agreed to settle the case under Chinese law.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，法請開江寧商埠。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, France requested opening Nanjing as a treaty port.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tongzhi, France requested opening Nanjing as a treaty port.

sentences.zh: 五年，議招工章程。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, regulations on labor recruitment were deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, regulations on labor recruitment were deliberated.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，四川酉陽州有殺傷教士案，又有貴州遵義民教仇殺事。

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year, Youyang subprefecture in Sichuan had a case of killing and wounding missionaries, and there was also a case of communal slaughter between Chinese and Christians in Zunyi, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the seventh year Youyang subprefecture in Sichuan had a case of killing and wounding missionaries, and Zunyi in Guizhou saw communal slaughter between Chinese and Christians.

sentences.zh: 法使羅淑亞上書稱遠臣，歸咎於中國官吏，且言當離京往津，候本國水師提督到後偕行，以為要脅。

translations.literal: French minister Rochechouart submitted a memorial calling himself a distant subject, blamed Chinese officials, and declared he would leave the capital for Tianjin to wait for his country's naval commander and travel together with him as coercion.
translations.idiomatic: French minister Rochechouart submitted a memorial styling himself a distant subject, blamed Chinese officials, and declared he would leave Beijing for Tianjin to wait for his country's naval commander and travel with him as a threat.

sentences.zh: 命湖廣總督李鴻章查辦，久之始結。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang, governor-general of Huguang, was ordered to investigate; only after a long time was the affair settled.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Li Hongzhang of Huguang was ordered to investigate; only after a long delay was the affair settled.

sentences.zh: 十二月，始遣欽使總理各國事務衙門章京志剛、孫家穀偕美前使蒲安臣至法遞國書，見其國主那波侖第三，復見其後，各致頌詞，成禮而退。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, envoys were first dispatched—Zongli Yamen clerks Zhigang and Sun Jiagu together with former American minister Burlingame—to France to deliver credentials; they were received by Napoleon III and again by the empress, each offered congratulatory words, and withdrew after the rites were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month China first dispatched envoys—Zongli Yamen clerks Zhigang and Sun Jiagu together with former American minister Burlingame—to France to present credentials; they were received by Napoleon III and again by the empress, exchanged congratulatory words, and withdrew after the rites were completed.

sentences.zh: 九年夏五月，天津民擊殺法領事豐大業。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer in the ninth year, Tianjin townspeople killed French consul Fontanier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer in the ninth year the people of Tianjin killed French consul Fontanier.

sentences.zh: 初，天津喧傳天主教堂迷拐幼孩，抉眼割心為藥料，人情洶洶。

translations.literal: At first Tianjin was abuzz with rumors that the Catholic church kidnapped children and gouged out eyes and cut out hearts for medicine; popular feeling was fiercely agitated.
translations.idiomatic: At first Tianjin was rife with rumors that the Catholic church kidnapped children and gouged out their eyes and hearts for medicine, and popular feeling ran high.

sentences.zh: 三口通商大臣崇厚等詣法領事豐大業赴堂同訊，觀者麕集。

translations.literal: On the third day Trade Commissioner Chonghou and others went with French consul Fontanier to the church for a joint inquiry; onlookers crowded thickly.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day Trade Commissioner Chonghou and others went with French consul Fontanier to the church for a joint inquiry, and a dense crowd gathered to watch.

sentences.zh: 偶與教堂人違言，磚石相拋擊，豐大業怒，徑至崇厚署忿詈，至擬以洋槍。

translations.literal: By chance words crossed with church people and bricks and stones were hurled; Fontanier in anger went straight to Chonghou's yamen and reviled him, even aiming a foreign gun at him.
translations.idiomatic: Words crossed with church people and bricks and stones flew; Fontanier in a rage went straight to Chonghou's yamen and abused him, even leveling a foreign gun at him.

sentences.zh: 出遇劉傑，復以槍擊傷某僕，遂群起毆斃豐大業，鳴鑼集眾，焚毀教堂、洋房數處，教民及洋人死者數十人。

translations.literal: Going out he met Liu Jie and again shot and wounded a servant; the crowd then rose as one and beat Fontanier to death, rang gongs to assemble the multitude, burned several churches and foreign houses; dozens of converts and foreigners died.
translations.idiomatic: Outside he met Liu Jie and shot and wounded a servant; the crowd then rose and beat Fontanier to death, rang gongs to rally the people, and burned several churches and foreign houses; dozens of converts and foreigners were killed.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命大學士直隸總督曾國籓赴津查辦。

translations.literal: When word reached the court, Grand Secretary and Zhili Governor-General Zeng Guofan was ordered to Tianjin to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, Grand Secretary and Zhili Governor-General Zeng Guofan was ordered to Tianjin to investigate.

sentences.zh: 國籓至津，示諭士民，宣佈懷柔外國、息事安民之意。

translations.literal: When Guofan reached Tianjin, he issued notices to gentry and people proclaiming the policy of gentle treatment of foreigners and quieting affairs to reassure the people.
translations.idiomatic: When Guofan reached Tianjin he issued proclamations to gentry and commoners, announcing the policy of conciliating foreigners and settling affairs to calm the people.

sentences.zh: 法公使羅淑亞來見，以四事相要：曰賠修教堂；

translations.literal: French minister Rochechouart came to an audience and pressed four demands: repair the churches;
translations.idiomatic: French minister Rochechouart came to an audience and pressed four demands: compensation and repair of the churches;

sentences.zh: 曰埋葬豐大業；

translations.literal: bury Fontanier;
translations.idiomatic: burial of Fontanier;

sentences.zh: 曰查辦地方官；

translations.literal: investigate local officials;
translations.idiomatic: investigation of local officials;

sentences.zh: 曰懲究兇手。

translations.literal: punish the culprits.
translations.idiomatic: punishment of the culprits.

sentences.zh: 尋牒請將府、縣官及提督陳國瑞抵罪，國籓拒之。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward a note requested that prefectural and county officials and Commander Chen Guorui be held criminally liable; Guofan refused.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward a note demanded that the prefect and county magistrate and Commander Chen Guorui be held criminally liable; Guofan refused.

sentences.zh: 與崇厚會奏，稱：「仁慈堂查出男女，訊無被拐情事，懇降諭各省，俾士民咸知謠傳多系虛誣，請將道、府、縣三員均撤任查辦。」

translations.literal: Together with Chonghou they jointly memorialized: 'At the Benevolent Hall men and women were examined and questioned, with no evidence of kidnapping; we beg an imperial edict to the provinces so that gentry and people may all know the rumors are largely false, and request that the circuit intendant, prefect, and county magistrate all be removed from office and investigated.'
translations.idiomatic: Together with Chonghou they memorialized: "Men and women found at the Benevolent Hall showed no evidence of kidnapping; we ask that an edict go out to the provinces so people will know the rumors are largely false, and request that the circuit intendant, prefect, and county magistrate all be removed and investigated."

sentences.zh: 奏入，報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and approved.

sentences.zh: 遂於八月擬結，辦為首十數人，天津府、縣減戍黑龍江。

translations.literal: In the eighth month a settlement was drafted: more than ten ringleaders were dealt with, and the Tianjin prefect and county magistrate were sentenced to reduced penal service in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a settlement was drafted: more than ten ringleaders were punished, and the Tianjin prefect and county magistrate were sentenced to penal service in Heilongjiang with reduced terms.

sentences.zh: 十一年，法遣全權大臣熱福里如京換約，並進書籍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year France sent plenipotentiary Théophile to Beijing to exchange treaties and also presented books.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year France sent plenipotentiary Théophile to Beijing to exchange treaties and presented books as gifts.

sentences.zh: 十二年，穆宗親政，各國請覲見，法與焉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the Muzong Emperor personally took power; the various states requested audiences, and France was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year Emperor Muzong assumed personal rule; the various powers requested audiences, and France was among them.

sentences.zh: 是年法人侵越南，入河內省城。

translations.literal: That year the French invaded Vietnam and entered Hanoi provincial city.
translations.idiomatic: That year the French invaded Vietnam and entered the provincial city of Hanoi.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，始遣兵部左侍郎郭嵩燾以英使兼法使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu, Left Vice Minister of War Guo Songtao was first dispatched as minister to Britain and concurrently minister to France.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu, Left Vice Minister of War Guo Songtao was first dispatched as minister to Britain and concurrently minister to France.

sentences.zh: 明年，代乙太常寺少卿曾紀澤。

translations.literal: The next year, Zeng Jize, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was replaced by Zeng Jize, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 越南向隸籓屬，自法據西貢，脅越人訂約，許于紅江通舟。

translations.literal: Vietnam had long been a tributary dependency; since France seized Saigon, it coerced the Vietnamese into a treaty permitting navigation on the Red River.
translations.idiomatic: Vietnam had long been a tributary state; after France seized Saigon it forced the Vietnamese into a treaty allowing navigation on the Red River.

sentences.zh: 曾紀澤與法外部言：「法、越私立之約，中國不能認。」

translations.literal: Zeng Jize said to the French Foreign Ministry: 'A private treaty between France and Vietnam China cannot recognize.'
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Jize told the French Foreign Ministry: 'A private treaty between France and Vietnam is one China cannot recognize.'

sentences.zh: 不省。

translations.literal: They did not heed it.
translations.idiomatic: The French paid no heed.

sentences.zh: 八年二月，法兵船由西貢駛至海防進口。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year French warships sailed from Saigon to Haiphong and entered port.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year French warships sailed from Saigon to Haiphong and entered the harbor.

sentences.zh: 三月，陷河內省。

translations.literal: In the third month they captured Hanoi province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month they took Hanoi province.

sentences.zh: 朝議始遣提督黃桂蘭等軍出關。

translations.literal: The court at last decided to send Commander Huang Guilan and other armies out through the passes.
translations.idiomatic: The court at last ordered Commander Huang Guilan and other forces out through the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 既而法公使寶海向北洋大臣李鴻章要求中國退兵，及通商保勝，驅逐盜賊，畫紅江南北為界。

translations.literal: Then French minister Ba Hai demanded of Beiyang Commissioner Li Hongzhang that China withdraw its troops, open trade at Baosheng, drive out bandits, and draw the Red River as the boundary between north and south.
translations.idiomatic: Then French minister Ba Hai demanded of Beiyang Commissioner Li Hongzhang that China withdraw its troops, open trade at Baosheng, drive out bandits, and fix the Red River as the boundary between north and south.

sentences.zh: 朝廷下各督撫議。

translations.literal: The court referred the matter to the governors-general and governors for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The court referred the matter to the provincial governors for discussion.

sentences.zh: 法人見不允所求，遂欲增軍撤使以相恫喝。

translations.literal: Seeing their demands refused, the French then wished to increase troops and withdraw the minister to intimidate.
translations.idiomatic: When the French saw their demands refused, they threatened to reinforce their armies and recall their minister.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，戰事起。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year hostilities began.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year fighting broke out.

sentences.zh: 法據南定，旋為劉永福所敗。

translations.literal: The French seized Nam Dinh and were soon defeated by Liu Yongfu.
translations.idiomatic: The French seized Nam Dinh but were soon defeated by Liu Yongfu.

sentences.zh: 會越王薨，法以兵脅嗣王立新約二十七條，盡攘其兵權、利權、政權，並申明越境全歸保護，中國不得干預。

translations.literal: When the Vietnamese king died, France used troops to coerce the successor king into a new treaty of twenty-seven articles, stripping away military, economic, and political power, and declaring the whole Vietnamese territory under French protection, with China forbidden to intervene.
translations.idiomatic: When the Vietnamese king died, France used force to make the new king sign a twenty-seven-article treaty that stripped Vietnam of military, economic, and political power, placed the whole country under French protection, and barred Chinese intervention.

sentences.zh: 中國聞之，乃命唐炯、徐延旭出關，彭玉麟辦粵防，張佩綸會辦軍務。

translations.literal: When China heard of this, it ordered Tang Jiong and Xu Yanxu out through the passes, Peng Yulin to manage Guangdong defenses, and Zhang Peilun to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When China heard of this, it ordered Tang Jiong and Xu Yanxu into Tonkin, Peng Yulin to organize Guangdong defenses, and Zhang Peilun to assist in military affairs.

sentences.zh: 會山西、北寧連陷，官軍退守太原，法乘勢擾浙、閩，陷基隆、澎湖，至是始宣戰。

translations.literal: When Shanxi [Sơn Tây] and Bac Ninh fell in succession, government troops retreated to defend Taiyuan [Thái Nguyên]; France took advantage to harass Zhejiang and Fujian, seized Keelung and Penghu, and only then did China declare war.
translations.idiomatic: When Sơn Tây and Bac Ninh fell in succession, Chinese forces fell back to Thái Nguyên; France then raided Zhejiang and Fujian, seized Keelung and Penghu, and only then did China declare war.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，諒山大捷，法忽請和，帝命吳大澂、陳寶琛、張佩綸會辦海防，以議和全權任李鴻章。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year came the great victory at Lang Son; France suddenly sought peace; the Emperor ordered Wu Dacheng, Chen Baochen, and Zhang Peilun to manage coastal defense jointly, and gave Li Hongzhang full powers to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the tenth year came the great victory at Lang Son; France suddenly sued for peace; the Emperor ordered Wu Dacheng, Chen Baochen, and Zhang Peilun to oversee coastal defense and gave Li Hongzhang full powers to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 先是福祿諾所擬五條，僅允不索兵費，不入滇境，而要脅中國不再與聞越事。

translations.literal: Earlier the five articles drafted by Fournier only promised not to demand military expenses or enter Yunnan territory, but coerced China to cease all concern with Vietnamese affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Fournier's five draft articles promised only not to demand indemnity or enter Yunnan, but required China to cease all involvement in Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 議久不決。

translations.literal: Negotiations dragged on without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: Talks dragged on without resolution.

sentences.zh: 五月，法兵以巡防為名，忽攻諒山，敗走。

translations.literal: In the fifth month French troops, under pretext of patrol duty, suddenly attacked Lang Son and were routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month French troops, claiming to be on patrol, suddenly attacked Lang Son and were driven back in defeat.

sentences.zh: 藉口中國不能如約退師，責賠費，不允。

translations.literal: They used as pretext that China had not withdrawn troops as agreed and demanded indemnity; this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: They claimed China had failed to withdraw troops as agreed and demanded indemnity; China refused.

sentences.zh: 法使巴德諾出京。

translations.literal: French minister Patenôtre left Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: French minister Patenôtre left Beijing.

sentences.zh: 六月，攻臺北基隆，為劉銘傳所敗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month they attacked Keelung in northern Taiwan and were defeated by Liu Mingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month they attacked Keelung in northern Taiwan and were defeated by Liu Mingchuan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，法水師提督孤拔等率兵船入閩，泊馬尾等處，迫交船廠，欲據為質。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn French naval commander Courbet and others led warships into Fujian, anchoring at Mawei and other places, pressing for surrender of the shipyard and wishing to hold it as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn French admiral Courbet led warships into Fujian, anchored at Mawei and elsewhere, demanded the shipyard, and sought to hold it hostage.

sentences.zh: 時張佩綸以會辦海防兼船政大臣，漫不設備，法遂開砲毀船廠。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Peilun, as joint manager of coastal defense and Superintendent of the Naval Dockyard, made no preparations whatsoever; the French then opened fire and destroyed the shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peilun, then joint overseer of coastal defense and Superintendent of the Naval Dockyard, had made no preparations; the French opened fire and destroyed the yard.

sentences.zh: 復分兵擾東京、臺灣，陷基隆，窺諒山。

translations.literal: They again divided forces to harass Tonkin and Taiwan, seized Keelung, and eyed Lang Son.
translations.idiomatic: They again sent detachments to harass Tonkin and Taiwan, seized Keelung, and threatened Lang Son.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，犯鎮南關，楊玉科戰沒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year they attacked Zhennan Pass; Yang Yuko died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year they attacked Zhennan Pass; Yang Yuko was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 旋收復，大創之，並砲斃孤拔於南洋。

translations.literal: Soon it was recovered and they inflicted a great defeat; Courbet was also killed by gunfire in the South Seas.
translations.idiomatic: The pass was soon retaken and the French suffered a crushing defeat; Courbet was also killed by shellfire in the South Seas.

sentences.zh: 法人乃請和，原照天津原約，不索償款。

translations.literal: The French then sought peace, reverting to the original Tianjin terms and demanding no indemnity.
translations.idiomatic: The French then sued for peace on the original Tianjin terms, demanding no indemnity.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章與議新約十條：一，法自行弭亂，華不派兵赴北圻；

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang negotiated a new treaty of ten articles: first, France would pacify disorder on its own and China would not send troops to Tonkin;
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang negotiated a new ten-article treaty: first, France would pacify Tonkin on its own and China would not send troops there;

sentences.zh: 二，法與越自立約，或已定或續立，中、越往來，不礙中國威望體面，亦不違此次約；

translations.literal: second, treaties France made or would make with Vietnam would not impair China's prestige or dignity in Sino-Vietnamese intercourse, nor violate this treaty;
translations.idiomatic: second, treaties France made or would make with Vietnam would not impair China's prestige in dealings with Vietnam, nor violate this treaty;

sentences.zh: 三，六個月會勘界，北圻界處或稍改正，以期兩益；

translations.literal: third, within six months boundaries would be jointly surveyed and Tonkin border sections might be slightly adjusted for mutual benefit;
translations.idiomatic: third, within six months the boundary would be jointly surveyed and Tonkin border sections might be slightly adjusted for mutual benefit;

sentences.zh: 四，法保護人民欲過界入中國，邊員給照，華人入越，請法給照；

translations.literal: fourth, French protected persons wishing to cross into China would receive passes from border officials, and Chinese entering Vietnam would request passes from France;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, French protected persons crossing into China would receive passes from border officials, and Chinese entering Vietnam would obtain passes from France;

sentences.zh: 五，保勝以西、諒山以北通商，華設關，法設領事，北圻亦可駐華領事；

translations.literal: fifth, trade west of Baosheng and north of Lang Son; China would establish customs houses, France consuls, and China might also station consuls in Tonkin;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, trade would open west of Baosheng and north of Lang Son; China would establish customs houses, France consuls, and China might also station consuls in Tonkin;

sentences.zh: 六，三個月內會定商款，法運越貨稅照他處較減；

translations.literal: sixth, commercial tariffs would be fixed within three months, with taxes on French goods shipped through Vietnam reduced compared with other places;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, commercial tariffs would be fixed within three months, with taxes on French goods shipped through Vietnam lower than elsewhere;

sentences.zh: 七，法在北圻造鐵路，中國若造鐵路，雇法工；

translations.literal: seventh, France might build railways in Tonkin; if China built railways, it would employ French workers;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, France might build railways in Tonkin; if China built railways, it would employ French workers;

sentences.zh: 八，此約十年再修；

translations.literal: eighth, this treaty would be revised in ten years;
translations.idiomatic: eighth, this treaty would be revised in ten years;

sentences.zh: 九，法即退基隆，二月內臺灣、澎湖全退，中、法前約照舊等語。

translations.literal: ninth, France would immediately withdraw from Keelung and fully evacuate Taiwan and Penghu within two months, with prior Sino-French treaties remaining in force, and similar provisions.
translations.idiomatic: ninth, France would immediately withdraw from Keelung and fully evacuate Taiwan and Penghu within two months, with prior Sino-French treaties remaining in force, and similar provisions.

sentences.zh: 旋法派戈可當代為駐華公使，欲改前約，出所擬二十四條。

translations.literal: Soon France sent Gérard as minister to China, wishing to alter the prior treaty and presenting twenty-four proposed articles.
translations.idiomatic: Soon France sent Gérard as minister to China, seeking to alter the prior treaty and presenting twenty-four proposed articles.

sentences.zh: 鴻章以與原約不符，不許。

translations.literal: Hongzhang refused on grounds they did not accord with the original treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang refused on the grounds that they conflicted with the original treaty.

sentences.zh: 戈使又欲辦滇、粵礦務，及製造土貨，運越南食鹽，復拒之。

translations.literal: Minister Gérard also wished to operate mines in Yunnan and Guangdong, manufacture native goods, and transport Vietnamese salt; these too were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Gérard also sought mining rights in Yunnan and Guangdong, manufacture of native goods, and transport of Vietnamese salt; these too were refused.

sentences.zh: 又欲於雲南省城及廣西內地設領事。

translations.literal: He also wished to establish consulates in Yunnan provincial capital and in the interior of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He also sought to establish consulates in the Yunnan provincial capital and in the interior of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 時正遣鄧承修、周德潤與法勘界，鴻章謂宜俟邊界勘明，方能指定通商碼頭。

translations.literal: At the time Deng Chenxiu and Zhou Derun were being sent to survey boundaries with France; Hongzhang said trade ports could be designated only after the border was surveyed.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Chenxiu and Zhou Derun were then surveying the boundary with France; Li Hongzhang said treaty ports could be designated only after the border was surveyed.

sentences.zh: 戈使又要求稅則減半，鴻章祗允五分減一。

translations.literal: Minister Gérard again demanded halving the tariff schedule; Hongzhang allowed only a one-fifth reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Gérard again demanded halving the tariff; Li Hongzhang allowed only a one-fifth reduction.

sentences.zh: 又另擬通商章程十八款，並將互交逃犯、洋藥進出口各條亦擬在內。

translations.literal: He also separately drafted eighteen articles of commercial regulations, including provisions on mutual extradition of fugitives and import and export of foreign opium.
translations.idiomatic: He also drafted eighteen articles of commercial regulations, including provisions on extradition of fugitives and import and export of foreign opium.

sentences.zh: 法使復援咸豐八年約內第七款有「工作」二字，仍要求增入在口製造，許之。

translations.literal: The French minister again cited the word 'work' in Article 7 of the eighth-year Xianfeng treaty and still demanded insertion of manufacture in the treaty ports; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The French minister cited the word 'work' in Article 7 of the Xianfeng eighth-year treaty and again demanded the right to manufacture in treaty ports; this was granted.

sentences.zh: 時雲南界務，周德潤會商岑毓英後，出關與法使狄隆晤商，擬先勘保勝上游一二段，並同擬全局辦法八條：一，中、法兩國勘界大臣等說明所應勘之界，俱是現在之界；

translations.literal: At the time for Yunnan boundary affairs, after Zhou Derun consulted with Cen Yuying, he went out through the passes to meet French minister Dillon; they planned first to survey one or two sections upstream of Baosheng, and jointly drafted eight general methods: first, Chinese and French boundary commissioners would clarify that the boundaries to be surveyed were all present boundaries;
translations.idiomatic: For the Yunnan boundary, after consulting Cen Yuying, Zhou Derun went out through the passes to meet French commissioner Dillon; they planned first to survey one or two sections upstream of Baosheng and jointly drafted eight general principles: first, Chinese and French boundary commissioners would clarify that the boundaries to be surveyed were the present boundaries;

sentences.zh: 一，勘現界後，或有改正之處，兩國勘界大臣公同商酌，如彼此意見不合，各請旨商辦；

translations.literal: second, after surveying present boundaries, any sections needing correction would be jointly discussed by both countries' boundary commissioners; if opinions differed, each would request instructions from his sovereign;
translations.idiomatic: second, after surveying the present boundary, any sections needing correction would be discussed jointly; if the commissioners disagreed, each would refer to his government;

sentences.zh: 一，續開勘雲、越交界，中國大臣等意欲一律勘完，所以照會法國請旨；

translations.literal: third, in continuing to survey the Yunnan-Vietnam border, Chinese commissioners wished to complete the survey in one go, and therefore notified France to request instructions;
translations.idiomatic: third, in continuing the Yunnan-Vietnam border survey, the Chinese commissioners wished to complete the entire survey at once and therefore notified France to seek instructions;

sentences.zh: 一，各大臣等商議先由老街勘到龍膊河，及龍膊河鄰近地方，復回老街，再勘老街鄰近地方；

translations.literal: fourth, the commissioners agreed to survey first from Lao Cai to the Long Bo River and neighboring areas, then return to Lao Cai and survey neighboring areas of Lao Cai;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, the commissioners agreed to survey first from Lao Cai to the Long Bo River and nearby areas, then return to Lao Cai and survey the areas near Lao Cai;

sentences.zh: 一，勘老街至龍膊河之界，中、法繪圖各官從紅江南岸歸，一路同走，中國繪圖官歸法國保護，自老街起至龍膊河止，兩國勘界大臣等各走雲、越邊界；

translations.literal: fifth, in surveying the boundary from Lao Cai to the Long Bo River, Chinese and French mapping officers would return along the south bank of the Red River, traveling together the whole way; Chinese mapping officers would be under French protection; from Lao Cai to the Long Bo River the boundary commissioners of both countries would each travel the Yunnan-Vietnam border;
translations.idiomatic: fifth, in surveying from Lao Cai to the Long Bo River, Chinese and French mapping officers would travel together along the south bank of the Red River, with Chinese officers under French protection; from Lao Cai to the Long Bo River each country's commissioners would travel the Yunnan-Vietnam border;

sentences.zh: 一，紅河自北河岸之老鏊至南岸之龍膊，以河中為界；

translations.literal: sixth, from Lao Ao on the north bank of the Red River to Long Bo on the south bank, the middle of the river would serve as the boundary;
translations.idiomatic: sixth, from Lao Ao on the north bank of the Red River to Long Bo on the south bank, the middle of the river would be the boundary;

sentences.zh: 一，雲、越之界，遇有以河為界，均以河中為界，如有全河現在歸中國界者，仍歸中國，現在歸越南界者，仍歸越南；

translations.literal: seventh, wherever the Yunnan-Vietnam border followed a river, the middle of the river would be the boundary; if an entire river now lay within Chinese territory it would remain Chinese, and if within Vietnamese territory it would remain Vietnamese;
translations.idiomatic: seventh, wherever the Yunnan-Vietnam border followed a river, the middle of the river would be the boundary; if an entire river now lay within Chinese territory it would remain so, and if within Vietnamese territory it would remain so;

sentences.zh: 一，勘界時隨處開節略圖說，均由兩國大臣等畫押。

translations.literal: eighth, during the survey brief maps and descriptions would be drawn up on the spot and signed by commissioners of both countries.
translations.idiomatic: eighth, during the survey brief maps and descriptions would be drawn up on the spot and signed by commissioners of both countries.

sentences.zh: 以上節略，彼此畫押遵守。

translations.literal: The above summary was signed by both sides and observed.
translations.idiomatic: The above summary was signed by both sides and was to be observed.

sentences.zh: 德潤與狄隆各按地圖校改，互有爭執，而於大小賭呪河、猛援、猛賴兩段，爭執尤力。

translations.literal: Derun and Dillon each revised according to maps and disputed one another; disputes were especially fierce over the sections of the Greater and Lesser Du Zhou River, Meng Yuan, and Meng Lai.
translations.idiomatic: Derun and Dillon each revised according to their maps and disputed one another; the disputes were especially fierce over the Greater and Lesser Du Zhou River and the Meng Yuan and Meng Lai sections.

sentences.zh: 會法勘路弁兵在者蘭被越遊勇所戕，法指為雲南提督散勇，中國不承，狄隆欲緩勘，但就圖定界。

translations.literal: When French survey-route soldiers were killed by Vietnamese irregulars at Zhelan, France accused them of being dispersed troops of the Yunnan commander; China did not admit this; Dillon wished to slow the survey and fix the boundary from maps alone.
translations.idiomatic: When French survey troops were killed by Vietnamese irregulars at Zhelan, France claimed they were dispersed troops of the Yunnan commander; China denied this; Dillon wished to suspend the survey and fix the boundary from maps alone.

sentences.zh: 粵東、粵西界務，鄧承修與張之洞、李秉衡等會商，其與法使浦理燮在關門文淵會議。

translations.literal: For eastern and western Guangdong boundary affairs, Deng Chenxiu consulted with Zhang Zhidong, Li Bingheng, and others; he met French minister Poulichou at Guanmen in Wenyuan.
translations.idiomatic: For the Guangdong boundary, Deng Chenxiu consulted with Zhang Zhidong, Li Bingheng, and others; he met French commissioner Poulichou at Guanmen in Wenyuan.

sentences.zh: 承修執約內「北圻邊界必要更正，以期兩國有益」之語，欲以諒山迤西自艽葑、高平省至保樂州，東自祿平、那陽、先妥州至海寧府劃歸中界。

translations.literal: Chenxiu cited the treaty phrase that 'Tonkin boundaries must be corrected for the benefit of both countries,' wishing to assign to China west of Lang Son from Mang Cai and Cao Bang province to Baole prefecture, and east from Luc Binh, Na Duong, and Tien Yen prefectures to Ha Ninh prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chenxiu cited the treaty language that 'Tonkin boundaries must be corrected for the benefit of both countries' and sought to assign to China west of Lang Son from Mang Cai and Cao Bang to Baole, and east from Luc Binh, Na Duong, and Tien Yen to Ha Ninh.

sentences.zh: 浦使以據約不過於兩邊界址略為更改，不能及諒山及東西地。

translations.literal: Minister Pou said that according to the treaty only slight changes on both sides of the boundary were permitted, and it could not extend to Lang Son and the eastern and western territories.
translations.idiomatic: Pou replied that under the treaty only slight adjustments on both sides of the boundary were permitted, and could not extend to Lang Son and the eastern and western territories.

sentences.zh: 旋允請示本國，卒不行。

translations.literal: He soon agreed to refer to his home country, but in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: He soon agreed to refer the matter to Paris, but in the end it was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 十二年復議界，會浦理燮病，僅由鎮南起勘至平關而止，東西不過三百餘里，餘未履勘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year boundary talks resumed; when Poulichou fell ill, surveying proceeded only from Zhennan to Pingguan, east to west no more than three hundred-odd li; the rest was not surveyed on the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year boundary talks resumed; when Poulichou fell ill, surveying ran only from Zhennan to Pingguan—a span of little more than three hundred li east to west; the rest was never surveyed on the ground.

sentences.zh: 浦理燮旋回國，法改派狄隆由滇赴粵，與鄧承修等議界。

translations.literal: Poulichou soon returned home; France replaced him with Dillon, who went from Yunnan to Guangdong to negotiate the boundary with Deng Chenxiu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Poulichou soon returned home, and France replaced him with Dillon, who traveled from Yunnan to Guangdong to negotiate the boundary with Deng Chenxiu and others.

sentences.zh: 先是鴻章欲先議界，後議商約，法使不從，乃復議商約。

translations.literal: Previously Hongzhang had wished to negotiate the boundary first and the commercial treaty afterward; the French minister would not agree, and so they returned to negotiating the commercial treaty.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang had wanted to settle the boundary first and the commercial treaty afterward, but the French minister refused, so negotiations turned back to the commercial treaty.

sentences.zh: 至是議成十九款：一，保勝以上某處、諒山以北某處，中國設關通商，許法設立領事；

translations.literal: At this point nineteen articles were agreed: first, at certain places above Baosheng and north of Lang Son, China would establish customs houses for trade and permit France to establish consuls;
translations.idiomatic: At this point nineteen articles were agreed. First, at designated points above Baosheng and north of Lang Son, China would open customs houses for trade and allow France to establish consuls.

sentences.zh: 二，中國可在河內、海防二處設立領事，並可商酌在北圻他處設領事，惟須後日；

translations.literal: second, China might establish consuls at Hanoi and Haiphong, and might also consult on establishing consuls elsewhere in Tonkin, but only at a later date;
translations.idiomatic: Second, China might establish consuls at Hanoi and Haiphong and could later discuss consular posts elsewhere in Tonkin.

sentences.zh: 三，兩國領事駐紮及商民通商，均須優待；

translations.literal: third, consuls of both countries in residence and merchants trading were all to receive favorable treatment;
translations.idiomatic: Third, consuls of both countries and their merchants were to receive favorable treatment.

sentences.zh: 四，中國人在越置地建屋，及官商往來公文、書信、電報，法允保護遞送；

translations.literal: fourth, Chinese who acquired land and built houses in Vietnam, and official and commercial correspondence, letters, and telegrams passing back and forth, France agreed to protect and deliver;
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, France agreed to protect Chinese land purchases and house-building in Vietnam and to safeguard and deliver official and commercial documents, letters, and telegrams.

sentences.zh: 五，兩國遊歷人過界，各發給護照；

translations.literal: fifth, travelers of both countries crossing the border would each be issued passports;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, travelers from both countries crossing the border would each receive passports.

sentences.zh: 六、七，出口貨照稅則三分減一，進口貨照稅則五分減一，估價之貨為稅則所未載者，進出口仍照值百抽五徵收，至洋土各貨赴內地買賣，應完子口稅，不在減徵之列；

translations.literal: sixth and seventh, export goods would receive a one-third reduction under the tariff schedule, import goods a one-fifth reduction; goods valued but not listed in the schedule would still be taxed at five percent ad valorem on import and export; as for foreign and native goods sent inland for sale, transit duties were payable and were not included in the reductions;
translations.idiomatic: Sixth and seventh, exports would receive a one-third tariff reduction and imports a one-fifth reduction; unlisted goods would still be taxed at five percent ad valorem, and foreign and native goods sent inland remained subject to transit duties and were excluded from the reductions.

sentences.zh: 八、九，載明洋、土各貨在邊關已完稅，復轉運通商各海關者，均照海關稅則另收正稅，不以邊關單作抵，其在邊關所領存票，亦只准在邊關抵稅，概不發還現銀；

translations.literal: eighth and ninth, it was stipulated that foreign and native goods that had paid duty at border passes and were then forwarded to treaty-port customs would all pay regular duty again according to the customs tariff, with border-pass receipts not accepted as credit; deposit tickets issued at border passes might be used only to offset duty at border passes and would in no case be redeemed in cash;
translations.idiomatic: Eighth and ninth, goods that had paid duty at a border pass and were then forwarded to treaty-port customs would pay full customs duty again; border-pass receipts could not be used as credit, and deposit tickets issued at border passes could offset duty only at those passes and would never be redeemed in cash.

sentences.zh: 十至十二，嚴防詐偽偷漏之法；

translations.literal: tenth through twelfth, methods for strictly guarding against fraud, forgery, and smuggling;
translations.idiomatic: Articles ten through twelve set out strict measures against fraud, forgery, and smuggling.

sentences.zh: 十三，定洋人自用雜物免稅之法；

translations.literal: thirteenth, methods were fixed for exempting foreigners' personal sundries from duty;
translations.idiomatic: Thirteenth, rules were fixed for duty-free treatment of foreigners' personal effects.

sentences.zh: 十四，定洋、土各藥不准販運買賣；

translations.literal: fourteenth, foreign and native drugs were fixed as not permitted for transport or sale;
translations.idiomatic: Fourteenth, the transport and sale of foreign and native drugs were prohibited.

sentences.zh: 十五，米穀等糧不准販運出中國邊關，進關准免稅，違禁物各禁；

translations.literal: fifteenth, rice, grain, and other foodstuffs were not permitted to be transported out through China's border passes; entry was allowed duty-free; prohibited articles were each forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: Fifteenth, rice and grain might not be exported through China's border passes; imports were duty-free; and all prohibited goods were banned.

sentences.zh: 十六，中國商民僑居越南，所有命案、賦稅、詞訟等件，法國應優待；

translations.literal: sixteenth, for Chinese merchants and commoners residing in Vietnam, in all cases of homicide, taxation, and litigation, France should show favorable treatment;
translations.idiomatic: Sixteenth, France was to treat Chinese merchants and commoners residing in Vietnam favorably in cases of homicide, taxation, and litigation.

sentences.zh: 十七，中國人犯罪，照中律，法領事宜拘送，不得庇匿；

translations.literal: seventeenth, when Chinese committed crimes, according to Chinese law French consular officials should arrest and deliver them and must not shelter or conceal them;
translations.idiomatic: Seventeenth, when Chinese committed crimes they were to be handled under Chinese law; French consular officials were to arrest and surrender offenders and must not shelter them.

sentences.zh: 十八、十九，定條約續修期限及互換遵守各事。

translations.literal: eighteenth and nineteenth, the period for treaty revision and matters of exchange and observance were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteenth and nineteenth, the schedule for treaty revision and provisions for exchange and compliance were fixed.

sentences.zh: 是為滇粵邊界通商約。

translations.literal: This was the Yunnan-Guangdong border trade treaty.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Yunnan-Guangdong border trade treaty.

sentences.zh: 商約既定，鄧承修即赴欽州之東興與狄隆議勘東界。

translations.literal: Once the commercial treaty was settled, Deng Chenxiu at once went to Dongxing in Qinzhou to discuss surveying the eastern boundary with Dillon.
translations.idiomatic: Once the commercial treaty was settled, Deng Chenxiu went to Dongxing in Qinzhou to discuss surveying the eastern boundary with Dillon.

sentences.zh: 狄隆以中國所屬江平、黃竹、白龍尾為越境。

translations.literal: Dillon held that Jiangping, Huangzhu, and Bailongwei, which belonged to China, were Vietnamese territory.
translations.idiomatic: Dillon claimed that Jiangping, Huangzhu, and Bailongwei—Chinese territory—belonged to Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 鄧承修以數地皆內地，有圖可據，不許。

translations.literal: Deng Chenxiu held that these places were all interior territory and maps could be cited as proof; he would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Chenxiu refused, citing maps to show that all these places lay within Chinese interior territory.

sentences.zh: 辯論不洽。

translations.literal: Debate reached no agreement.
translations.idiomatic: The talks broke down.

sentences.zh: 狄隆又約履勘，承修欲照雲南分途履勘辦法，並請先撤江平法兵。

translations.literal: Dillon again proposed an on-the-ground survey; Chenxiu wished to follow the Yunnan method of surveying by separate routes and requested first that French troops at Jiangping be withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Dillon again proposed a ground survey; Chenxiu wanted to follow the Yunnan practice of surveying by separate routes and asked that French troops at Jiangping be withdrawn first.

sentences.zh: 越日，復議請旨立約三條：一，大段相合；

translations.literal: The next day, in renewed talks he requested imperial approval to establish three articles: first, where large sections agreed;
translations.idiomatic: The next day he proposed three articles for imperial approval: first, where major sections of the boundary agreed,

sentences.zh: 二，較圖不合，作為未定，各請示本國；

translations.literal: second, where they disagreed with the maps, treat as undetermined and each side refer to its home country;
translations.idiomatic: second, where the maps disagreed, treat the matter as undetermined and refer it to each government;

sentences.zh: 三，勒其去江平之兵及辦事官員。

translations.literal: third, compel withdrawal of troops and administrative officials from Jiangping.
translations.idiomatic: third, compel withdrawal of troops and officials from Jiangping.

sentences.zh: 又令以後未定界內，不得再派兵及官員前往。

translations.literal: He also ordered that thereafter within undetermined boundaries no troops or officials might again be sent.
translations.idiomatic: He also stipulated that neither side might again send troops or officials into undetermined territory.

sentences.zh: 狄隆不允，轉要承修不得於未定界內駐兵。

translations.literal: Dillon would not agree and in turn demanded that Chenxiu not station troops within undetermined boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Dillon refused and in turn demanded that Chenxiu not station troops in undetermined territory.

sentences.zh: 時張之洞所派道員王之春、李興銳亦與會議。

translations.literal: At the time the circuit intendant Wang Zhichun and Li Xingrui, dispatched by Zhang Zhidong, also joined the conference.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit intendant Wang Zhichun and Li Xingrui, whom Zhang Zhidong had dispatched, also joined the talks.

sentences.zh: 議界將及一年，中國屢請撤兵，法兵分屯江平、黃竹、石角、句冬、白龍尾等處如故。

translations.literal: Boundary talks had lasted nearly a year; China repeatedly requested troop withdrawal, yet French troops remained garrisoned as before at Jiangping, Huangzhu, Shijiao, Goudong, Bailongwei, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Boundary talks had dragged on for nearly a year. China repeatedly asked for troop withdrawal, but French forces remained garrisoned at Jiangping, Huangzhu, Shijiao, Goudong, Bailongwei, and other points.

sentences.zh: 會總署允承修所定三條，承修命王之春往議，狄隆執不允，而法人突以兵踞白龍尾，驅害汛兵。

translations.literal: When the Zongli Yamen approved Chenxiu's three articles, Chenxiu ordered Wang Zhichun to go negotiate; Dillon stubbornly refused, while the French suddenly seized Bailongwei by force and drove off and harmed the garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zongli Yamen approved Chenxiu's three articles, Chenxiu sent Wang Zhichun to negotiate, but Dillon stubbornly refused; meanwhile French troops suddenly seized Bailongwei and drove off the garrison.

sentences.zh: 華民築營壘，承修詰令撤退，狄隆諉之。

translations.literal: Chinese commoners built fortifications; Chenxiu demanded their withdrawal, and Dillon disclaimed responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese residents built fortifications; Chenxiu demanded their removal, and Dillon disclaimed responsibility.

sentences.zh: 時桂界已校竣，欽界南自嘉隆河、北抵北侖十萬山分茅嶺、西至峒中墟北，亦允歸中國，而白龍、江平，狄隆謂須以商務抵換。

translations.literal: At the time the Guangxi boundary had already been surveyed and completed; for the Qinzhou boundary, from the Jialong River in the south north to Fenmao Ridge in the Shiwan Mountains of Beilun, west to north of Dongzhong Market, China was also allowed to retain territory; but as for Bailong and Jiangping, Dillon said commercial concessions must be exchanged for them.
translations.idiomatic: The Guangxi boundary had already been settled; for the Qinzhou section, from the Jialong River in the south to Fenmao Ridge in the Beilun Shiwan Mountains and west to north of Dongzhong Market, China had also been allowed to retain territory. But Dillon insisted that Bailong and Jiangping must be traded for commercial concessions.

sentences.zh: 又以九頭山未議，及之春與議，亦無效。

translations.literal: Because Jiutou Mountain had not yet been discussed, Zhichun joined the talks, but this too had no effect.
translations.idiomatic: Jiutou Mountain remained unsettled; Zhichun joined the talks, but to no effect.

sentences.zh: 狄隆又欲議海界，以津約所無，未奉旨議海界，卻之。

translations.literal: Dillon again wished to negotiate the maritime boundary; because the Tianjin treaty contained no such provision and no imperial order had authorized discussion of a maritime boundary, this was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Dillon again sought to negotiate the maritime boundary, but China refused: the Tianjin treaty made no such provision, and no imperial order authorized it.

sentences.zh: 法又欲以白龍、江平抵換龍州通商。

translations.literal: France also wished to exchange Bailong and Jiangping for trade at Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: France also sought to trade Bailong and Jiangping for opening trade at Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 初恭思當來華也，即有求改商約之請，總署以界務方殷，且商約既經畫押，何能議改？

translations.literal: When Gérard first came to China, he had already requested revision of the commercial treaty; the Zongli Yamen held that boundary affairs were still pressing and that since the commercial treaty had already been signed and sealed, how could it be reopened for revision?
translations.idiomatic: When Gérard first arrived in China he had already asked to revise the commercial treaty. The Zongli Yamen replied that boundary affairs were still urgent and that a treaty already signed and sealed could not be reopened.

sentences.zh: 拒之。

translations.literal: This was refused.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 至是復以為請，並以商務苟可通融，界務亦可稍讓。

translations.literal: At this point he again made the request, and stated that if commercial matters could be accommodated, boundary affairs might also be slightly conceded.
translations.idiomatic: He now renewed the request, offering that if commercial terms could be accommodated, China might make slight concessions on the boundary.

sentences.zh: 稱已奉本國訓，准令在京商辦。

translations.literal: He stated that he had received instructions from his home country authorizing negotiation in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He said he had received instructions from Paris authorizing negotiations in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 總署以狄隆與鄧承修議界久不決，允與商辦。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen, because Dillon and Deng Chenxiu's boundary talks had long remained unsettled, agreed to negotiate.
translations.idiomatic: Because Dillon and Deng Chenxiu had failed for so long to settle the boundary, the Zongli Yamen agreed to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 恭思當始允中國廣東邊界除現在勘界大臣劃定外，所有白龍尾及江平、黃竹一帶地方，並雲南邊界前歸另議之南丹山以北、西至狗頭寨、東至清水河一帶地方，均歸中國管轄。

translations.literal: Gérard then agreed that on China's Guangdong boundary, apart from what the present boundary commissioners had already demarcated, all the area of Bailongwei and the Jiangping-Huangzhu strip, and on the Yunnan boundary the area previously left for separate discussion north of Nandanshan, west to Goutouzhai and east to Qingshui River, would all fall under Chinese jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Gérard then agreed that on the Guangdong boundary, aside from what the current commissioners had demarcated, Bailongwei and the Jiangping-Huangzhu strip would remain under Chinese jurisdiction, as would the Yunnan section previously left open—north of Nandanshan, west to Goutouzhai, and east to the Qingshui River.

sentences.zh: 又議減稅，總署以俄國通商章程辦有成案，滇、桂邊界皆為陸路，不得不酌議減稅，以歸平允。

translations.literal: Tariff reductions were also discussed; the Zongli Yamen held that since Russia's commercial regulations had established precedent and the Yunnan and Guangxi boundaries were all overland routes, tariff reductions had to be considered to restore equity.
translations.idiomatic: Tariff reductions were also discussed. The Zongli Yamen noted that Russia's commercial regulations had set a precedent and that overland routes on the Yunnan and Guangxi borders required some tariff relief to restore fairness.

sentences.zh: 於是議進口稅減十分之三，出口稅減十分之四，滇土藥每百斤定稅釐各二十兩，必完釐者，方准法商完稅接買，並不准法、越商人往入內地販運，高平、諒山往來之船隻免徵稅，仍納船錢，惟運販食鹽、接辦鐵路及越南與滇、粵通商進出口稅則，均請減半，運中國土貨往中國各海口，稅則減三分之一各節，均拒絕刪節。

translations.literal: Accordingly import duty was reduced by three-tenths and export duty by four-tenths; Yunnan native drugs were fixed at twenty taels each of regular duty and likin per hundred catties, and only after likin was paid might French merchants pay duty and purchase; French and Vietnamese merchants were also not permitted to enter the interior to transport and sell; vessels traveling between Gaoping and Lang Son were exempt from tax but still paid boat fees; but provisions on transporting and selling salt, undertaking railways, halving import and export tariffs for Vietnam-Yunnan-Guangdong trade, and reducing tariffs by one-third on Chinese native goods shipped to China's various seaports were all refused and struck out.
translations.idiomatic: Import duty was cut by three-tenths and export duty by four-tenths. Yunnan native drugs were fixed at twenty taels each of regular duty and likin per hundred catties; French merchants might purchase only after likin was paid, and French and Vietnamese merchants were barred from inland transport and sale. Vessels between Gaoping and Lang Son were tax-exempt but still paid boat fees. China rejected French demands to halve tariffs on salt, railways, and Vietnam-Yunnan-Guangdong trade and to cut duties by one-third on native goods shipped to China's seaports.

sentences.zh: 計訂商務續約十條，界務續約四條。

translations.literal: In all, a commercial supplementary treaty of ten articles and a boundary supplementary treaty of four articles were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: In all, a ten-article commercial supplementary treaty and a four-article boundary supplementary treaty were concluded.

sentences.zh: 又照會緩設領事，及法在龍、蒙等處之領事等官，不得設立租界二端。

translations.literal: Notes were also exchanged deferring establishment of consuls and stipulating that French consuls and other officials at Longzhou, Mengzi, and other places might not establish concessions—two points.
translations.idiomatic: Notes were also exchanged deferring consular establishment and stipulating that French consular officials at Longzhou, Mengzi, and elsewhere might not establish concessions.

sentences.zh: 是為與法勘界通商續約。

translations.literal: This was the supplementary treaty on boundary survey and trade with France.
translations.idiomatic: This was the Sino-French supplementary treaty on boundary demarcation and trade.

sentences.zh: 十四年，法領事藉口華船常到海防，向廉州請示諭船戶須向領事領照，無照即將船扣留。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the French consul, on pretext that Chinese vessels often came to Haiphong, requested instructions from Lianzhou ordering boat owners to obtain licenses from the consul, with vessels to be detained if unlicensed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year the French consul, citing frequent visits by Chinese vessels to Haiphong, asked Lianzhou to order boat owners to obtain consular licenses on pain of detention.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以條約向章所無，海防各國船隻均可往，何獨華船不許？

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong held that no such provision existed in prior treaty chapters; vessels of all countries might go to Haiphong—why alone forbid Chinese vessels?
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong replied that no treaty authorized this: vessels of all nations might enter Haiphong, so why forbid Chinese ships alone?

sentences.zh: 嗣聞法領事張貼告白，收取船規，每船輸銀自數元至數十元不等，雲系法使所定。

translations.literal: Later it was heard that the French consul posted a public notice collecting boat fees, each vessel paying silver from several yuan to several tens of yuan, stating this had been fixed by the French minister.
translations.idiomatic: Later the French consul posted a notice collecting boat fees of several to several dozen yuan per vessel, claiming the French minister had authorized them.

sentences.zh: 之洞致總署請其停止收規。

translations.literal: Zhidong wrote the Zongli Yamen requesting that the fee collection be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong wrote the Zongli Yamen asking that the fees be stopped.

sentences.zh: 是年，法人請接中國兩粵電線，許之。

translations.literal: That year, the French requested connection to China's Guangdong and Guangxi telegraph lines; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year France requested connection to Guangdong and Guangxi telegraph lines, and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 又芒街法兵越界焚劫那沙，之洞致總署，請向法使責賠償。

translations.literal: Also, French troops at Mong Cai crossed the border to burn and plunder Nasha; Zhidong wrote the Zongli Yamen requesting that the French minister be held liable for compensation.
translations.idiomatic: French troops at Mong Cai also crossed the border to burn and plunder Nasha; Zhang Zhidong wrote the Zongli Yamen asking that the French minister be held liable for compensation.

sentences.zh: 十五年，法船駛進瓊州所屬崖州東百里之榆林港測探水道，上岸釘椿插標，阻之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, French vessels entered Yulin Harbor, one hundred li east of Yazhou under Qiongzhou, to survey the channel; they went ashore to drive stakes and set markers, and were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year French vessels entered Yulin Harbor, a hundred li east of Yazhou in Qiongzhou, to survey the channel; when they went ashore to drive stakes and set markers, they were stopped.

sentences.zh: 法領事又在北海徵收漁船照費，政府以有侵中國主權，不許。

translations.literal: The French consul also collected license fees from fishing boats at Beihai; the government held this infringed Chinese sovereignty and would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The French consul also collected license fees from fishing boats at Beihai; the government refused, holding that this infringed Chinese sovereignty.

sentences.zh: 十月，定界委員李受彤與法官勘東興一帶河界，定議此後河中淤有沙洲，近華者歸華，近越者歸越，河道即有更改，無論河在何境，兩國均許行船。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, boundary commissioner Li Shoutong and French officials surveyed the river boundary around Dongxing; it was agreed that hereafter if sandbars formed from silt in the river, those nearer China would belong to China and those nearer Vietnam to Vietnam; even if the channel changed, regardless of which territory the river lay in, both countries would permit navigation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month boundary commissioner Li Shoutong and French officials surveyed the river boundary around Dongxing. They agreed that future sandbars would belong to whichever side they lay nearer, and that even if the channel shifted, both countries would allow navigation regardless of which territory the river crossed.

sentences.zh: 是年，法使以華兵駐越南之板邦為言。

translations.literal: That year, the French minister raised the matter of Chinese troops stationed at Banbang in Vietnam.
translations.idiomatic: That year the French minister protested that Chinese troops were stationed at Banbang in Vietnam.

sentences.zh: 又稱那沙墟不在中國界內，實在北圻橫模社對面先安河北岸，與板邦相近。

translations.literal: He also stated that Nasha Market was not within Chinese territory but actually lay on the north bank of the Xian'an River opposite Hengmo commune in Tonkin, near Banbang.
translations.idiomatic: He also claimed that Nasha Market lay outside Chinese territory—on the north bank of the Xian'an River opposite Hengmo commune in Tonkin, near Banbang.

sentences.zh: 又稱去冬官兵迎收被剿敗匪，系指離芒街八里之寧陽大廟對面大河北岸而言。

translations.literal: He also stated that last winter when government troops received defeated bandits who had been suppressed, this referred to the north bank of the great river opposite Ningyang Temple, eight li from Mong Cai.
translations.idiomatic: He also said that when government troops last winter received defeated bandits, this referred to the north bank of the great river opposite Ningyang Temple, eight li from Mong Cai.

sentences.zh: 並命查復。

translations.literal: He also ordered an investigation and reply.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered an investigation and report.

sentences.zh: 嗣李受彤復電，謂：「州西分界，自八莊曆板興、板山、冷峒止，前有溝離越南峒中三里，即以此溝為界，冷峒系醜艮寅向，峒中系未坤申向，那沙在西北，戌乾亥向，峒中墟居中，兩旁有溝，水向西合流入先安省。

translations.literal: Later Li Shoutong telegraphed again, stating: 'On the western boundary of the prefecture, from Bazhuang through Banxing, Banshan, and Lengdong, three li before this there is a ditch three li from Vietnamese Dongzhong; this ditch is taken as the boundary. Lengdong lies in the chou-gen-yin direction; Dongzhong in the wei-kun-shen direction; Nasha in the northwest, xu-qian-hai direction. Dongzhong Market stands in the center, with ditches on both sides; the waters merge westward and flow into Xian'an province.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shoutong telegraphed again: 'On the prefecture's western boundary, from Bazhuang through Banxing, Banshan, and Lengdong, a ditch three li from Vietnamese Dongzhong serves as the boundary. Lengdong lies to the northeast, Dongzhong to the southwest, and Nasha to the northwest. Dongzhong Market stands at the center with ditches on both sides; their waters merge westward into Xian'an province.

sentences.zh: 以方向論，溝西南概為越地，溝西北概為華地。

translations.literal: By direction, southwest of the ditch is generally Vietnamese territory and northwest of the ditch is generally Chinese territory.
translations.idiomatic: By compass bearing, territory southwest of the ditch is Vietnamese and northwest of it is Chinese.

sentences.zh: 以社論，那沙與板峒為建延社地，與峒中為橫模社地無涉。

translations.literal: By commune, Nasha and Bandong belong to Jianyan commune and have nothing to do with Dongzhong in Hengmo commune.
translations.idiomatic: By administrative commune, Nasha and Bandong belong to Jianyan commune and have no connection with Dongzhong in Hengmo commune.

sentences.zh: 以交界論，那沙北曆那懷，約二十五里即北岩，系廣西上思州地。

translations.literal: By adjacent boundaries, north of Nasha through Nahua, about twenty-five li further is Beiyan, which is territory of Shangsi Prefecture in Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: By adjacent boundaries, north of Nasha through Nahua, about twenty-five li further lies Beiyan, which belongs to Shangsi Prefecture in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 以欽差所定界圖論，那懷屬我，那沙即附連那懷，相離僅三里，前並無墟。

translations.literal: According to the boundary map fixed by the imperial commissioner, Nahua belongs to us; Nasha adjoins Nahua, separated by only three li; previously there was no market there.
translations.idiomatic: On the imperial commissioner's boundary map, Nahua belongs to China; Nasha adjoins it only three li away, and no market existed there before.

sentences.zh: 去年正月，峒中墟華民始由峒中遷此。

translations.literal: In the first month of last year, Chinese commoners from Dongzhong Market first moved here from Dongzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Last year in the first month, Chinese residents from Dongzhong Market first moved here from Dongzhong.

sentences.zh: 去年十一月以前，法未逾溝到此，十二月始有焚殺那沙墟事，擄去婦女，隨即給銀放回。

translations.literal: Before the eleventh month of last year the French had not crossed the ditch to this place; only in the twelfth month did the burning and killing at Nasha Market occur, with women carried off and then released after payment of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Before the eleventh month of last year the French had not crossed the ditch; in the twelfth month they burned Nasha Market and carried off women, who were released after ransom was paid.

sentences.zh: 其法官自向婦女言系逾界誤拏。

translations.literal: The French official himself told the women it was a mistaken seizure across the border.
translations.idiomatic: The French official himself told the women they had been seized by mistake across the border.

sentences.zh: 再查界圖，西北有板邦隘，系廣西地。

translations.literal: Checking the boundary map again, to the northwest there is Banbang Pass, which is Guangxi territory.
translations.idiomatic: The boundary map shows Banbang Pass to the northwest, which is Guangxi territory.

sentences.zh: 又土人言橫模西南離六十里有板邦，屬越地。

translations.literal: Local people also say that sixty li southwest of Hengmo there is a Banbang that belongs to Vietnamese territory.
translations.idiomatic: Locals also say that sixty li southwest of Hengmo lies another Banbang, which is Vietnamese territory.

sentences.zh: 峒中之東並無板邦，只有板奔，離峒中約九里，系內地。

translations.literal: East of Dongzhong there is no Banbang, only Banben, about nine li from Dongzhong, which is interior territory.
translations.idiomatic: East of Dongzhong there is no Banbang—only Banben, about nine li away, which lies within Chinese interior territory.

sentences.zh: 去年秋，萃軍防營駐此，因疫退駐板興，今板奔並無防勇。
