translations.literal: Last autumn the Cuigun garrison camp was stationed here; because of epidemic they withdrew to Banxing; now at Banben there are no garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn the Cuigun garrison was posted here but withdrew to Banxing because of disease; Banben now has no troops.

sentences.zh: 又查寧陽離芒街十餘里，在東興西南，中隔河，必船乃渡，即有勇亦難迎庇，且並無勇。」

translations.literal: Investigation also shows that Ningyang is more than ten li from Mong Cai, southwest of Dongxing, with a river between; one must cross by boat; even if there were troops they could hardly receive and shelter bandits there, and moreover there are no troops.'
translations.idiomatic: Ningyang lies more than ten li from Mong Cai, southwest of Dongxing, with a river in between that requires a boat to cross; even if troops were present they could hardly shelter bandits there—and in fact there are none.'

sentences.zh: 等語。

translations.literal: —and similar remarks.
translations.idiomatic: —and similar remarks.

sentences.zh: 又馮子材電亦云然。

translations.literal: Feng Zicai's telegram also said the same.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Zicai's telegram said the same.

sentences.zh: 張之洞以兩說歧異，由於華民以溝水為界，法以先安河北岸為界。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhidong held that the two accounts diverged because Chinese commoners took the ditch waters as the boundary while the French took the north bank of the Xian'an River as the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong held that the dispute arose because Chinese residents took the ditch as the boundary while the French took the north bank of the Xian'an River.

sentences.zh: 溝即河也，原圖均未指明。

translations.literal: The ditch is the river; the original maps specified neither.
translations.idiomatic: The ditch is the river, and the original maps specified neither.

sentences.zh: 那沙系去年正月新立之墟，距界甚近，故致彼此爭執。

translations.literal: Nasha was a market newly established in the first month of last year, very close to the boundary, and so caused dispute on both sides.
translations.idiomatic: Nasha was a market newly established last year in the first month, very close to the boundary, which explains the dispute.

sentences.zh: 既悉板邦隘另是一地，實屬廣西。

translations.literal: Once it was clear that Banbang Pass was a separate place, it truly belonged to Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Once it was established that Banbang Pass was a separate place, it clearly belonged to Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月，歸逃人魏名高等十八人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the sixteenth year, eighteen fugitives including Wei Minggao were returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the sixteenth year, eighteen fugitives including Wei Minggao were returned.

sentences.zh: 十七年八月，法使林椿改擬新咖雷多尼招工合同第十四條。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, French minister Lin Chun revised Article Fourteen of the New Caledonia labor-recruitment contract.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the seventeenth year, French minister Lin Chun revised Article Fourteen of the New Caledonia labor contract.

sentences.zh: 緣第十四條中國原擬派員作「理事官」，林使不允，改作為「華工統領」，所得權利僅止赴訴公堂及請狀師理論。

translations.literal: Because in Article Fourteen China had originally proposed dispatching an official styled 'commissioner,' Minister Lin would not agree and changed it to 'leader of Chinese laborers,' with rights limited only to bringing suit in court and requesting a barrister to argue the case.
translations.idiomatic: China had originally proposed dispatching an official titled 'commissioner' under Article Fourteen; Minister Lin refused and changed the title to 'leader of Chinese laborers,' limiting the post to bringing suit in court and retaining counsel.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章以所改仍與工頭無異，焉得有權保護？

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang held that the revised title differed in no way from a labor contractor—how could it possess protective authority?
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang replied that the revised title was no different from a labor contractor's—how could it carry protective authority?

sentences.zh: 不許。

translations.literal: This was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 時湖南民攻詆洋教，法領事欲赴長沙開馬頭、設教堂，阻之。

translations.literal: At the time Hunan commoners attacked and reviled foreign religion; the French consul wished to go to Changsha to open a trading wharf and establish a church, and was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan residents were attacking foreign missions; when the French consul sought to open a wharf and church in Changsha, he was blocked.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月，請東興、芒街接修電線。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year, a request was made to connect telegraph lines between Dongxing and Mong Cai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the nineteenth year France requested a telegraph connection between Dongxing and Mong Cai.

sentences.zh: 粵督以前辦界案，尚有數十里至今未定，遽與接線，界未劃定之處歸何人保護？

translations.literal: The Guangdong governor-general held that in the prior boundary case several tens of li remained undetermined to this day; to connect lines hastily—who would protect places where the boundary was not yet fixed?
translations.idiomatic: The governor-general of Guangdong replied that in the earlier boundary negotiations several tens of li remained unsettled; if lines were connected hastily, who would protect undemarcated territory?

sentences.zh: 必致多生轇轕。

translations.literal: This would inevitably give rise to many complications.
translations.idiomatic: It would inevitably cause endless complications.

sentences.zh: 仍促先速定界。

translations.literal: He still urged that the boundary first be fixed quickly.
translations.idiomatic: He urged that the boundary be settled first.

sentences.zh: 二十年，法使日海遞國書。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, French minister Harmand presented his letter of credence.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year French minister Harmand presented his letter of credence.

sentences.zh: 又議寓越華人減身稅事，並論暹羅邊界。

translations.literal: He also discussed reducing the poll tax on Chinese residing in Vietnam and discussed the Siamese boundary.
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed reducing the poll tax on Chinese in Vietnam and raised the Siamese boundary.

sentences.zh: 李鴻章據英與法議暹羅交界有甌脫地，應歸中國，日海不允。

translations.literal: Li Hongzhang, citing British and French discussions of the Sino-Siamese border, held that buffer territory should belong to China; Harmand would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hongzhang, citing Anglo-French discussions of the Sino-Siamese border, argued that buffer territory should belong to China; Harmand refused.

sentences.zh: 三月，與法會勘欽、越界。

translations.literal: In the third month, a joint survey with France of the Qinzhou-Vietnam boundary was conducted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month China and France jointly surveyed the Qinzhou-Vietnam boundary.

sentences.zh: 初，法派巴拉第、法蘭亭均以約內載明屬我之板興、嶺懷等處爭為己有，政府不允。

translations.literal: Initially France had sent Barradé and Franquet, who both claimed Banxing, Linghuai, and other places clearly stipulated in the treaty as belonging to China as their own; the government would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: France had initially sent Barradé and Franquet, who claimed Banxing, Linghuai, and other places the treaty assigned to China; the government refused.

sentences.zh: 至是法改派柯麻暨其總辦籞釐籥接辦。

translations.literal: At this point France replaced them with Commaille and his chief officer Yu Liyue to take over.
translations.idiomatic: France now replaced them with Commaille and his chief officer Yu Liyue.

sentences.zh: 粵督李瀚章派李受彤與會勘，始知巴拉第、法蘭亭所爭險要，與越南皆隔深溝峻嶺，而溝尤多。

translations.literal: Guangdong governor-general Li Hanzhang dispatched Li Shoutong to join the survey and learned that the strategic points Barradé and Franquet had disputed were all separated from Vietnam by deep ditches and steep ridges, ditches being especially numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-general Li Hanzhang sent Li Shoutong to join the survey and found that the strategic points Barradé and Franquet had disputed were separated from Vietnam by deep ravines and steep ridges, with ravines especially numerous.

sentences.zh: 因與約定，按界線有水處以水為界，有山處以山為界，計長四百里。

translations.literal: Accordingly they agreed that where the boundary line had water, water would serve as the boundary, and where it had mountains, mountains would serve as the boundary; the total length was four hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: They agreed that water would mark the boundary where water lay along the line and mountains where mountains lay—a total length of four hundred li.

sentences.zh: 陸界僅五十里，皆峻嶺，餘悉溝界，惟披勞縱橫約三里，各分一半。

translations.literal: The land boundary was only fifty li, all steep ridges; the rest was all ditch boundary; only Pilao, about three li across, was divided in half by each side.
translations.idiomatic: Only fifty li of land boundary ran along steep ridges; the rest followed ravines, except Pilao—about three li across—which was divided equally.

sentences.zh: 餘如原勘圖約所載，分茅嶺、板興、板典、嶺懷等處，及峒中十里，均歸中國。

translations.literal: The rest, as recorded in the original survey maps and agreements—Fenmao Ridge, Banxing, Bandian, Linghuai, and other places, and ten li around Dongzhong—all reverted to China.
translations.idiomatic: As the original survey maps and agreements recorded, Fenmao Ridge, Banxing, Bandian, Linghuai, and ten li around Dongzhong all remained with China.

sentences.zh: 時滇、越亦議界。

translations.literal: At the time Yunnan and Vietnam were also negotiating the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan and Vietnam were negotiating their boundary at the same time.

sentences.zh: 滇督王文韶不允爭已定界，祗就黃樹皮、箐門及猛岡各處向駐有華兵處，緩撤兵以待法防之至。

translations.literal: Yunnan governor-general Wang Wenshao would not dispute already fixed boundaries; he only at Huangshupi, Qingmen, Menggang, and other places where Chinese troops had been stationed ordered a gradual troop withdrawal to await the arrival of French garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan governor-general Wang Wenshao refused to reopen settled boundaries; he ordered only a gradual withdrawal from Huangshupi, Qingmen, Menggang, and other posts where Chinese troops were stationed, pending arrival of French garrisons.

sentences.zh: 界約遂定。

translations.literal: The boundary agreement was thus fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The border agreement was settled.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，中、日約成，法求換商約、界約，遂許開龍州、蒙自等埠，並與越界線內猛烏、烏得二地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the Sino-Japanese treaty was concluded; France requested the renewal of commercial and boundary treaties, and China thereupon permitted the opening of treaty ports at Longzhou, Mengzi, and other places, and also ceded within the Vietnam boundary line the two places of Mengwu and Wude.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, after the Sino-Japanese treaty was concluded, France sought revisions of the commercial and boundary agreements; China then allowed Longzhou, Mengzi, and other ports to open and ceded Mengwu and Wude within the Vietnamese border.

sentences.zh: 初，中國認此二地為寧洱縣屬車裏土司之地，法使謂舊屬越，遂歸法有。

translations.literal: Initially China regarded these two places as territory of the Cheli native chieftain under Ning'er County; the French minister claimed they had long belonged to Vietnam, and they thereupon passed to French possession.
translations.idiomatic: China had originally considered these two districts part of the Cheli native chieftaincy under Ning'er County, but the French minister argued they had long belonged to Vietnam, and they were accordingly ceded to France.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，法要求瓊州不割讓租借於他國，許之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, France requested that Qiongzhou not be ceded or leased to other powers; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year France demanded a pledge that Qiongzhou would not be ceded or leased to any other power; China agreed.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，法乘廣東雷州人殺其士民二人，以兵艦據廣州灣，來商租借，言為停船屯煤之所，無損中國主權，而所租借跨高、雷二府之間，由海岸以入內地，所得東海、匈洲各島，及赤坎、志滿、新墟等處，均歸入租界。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, France, taking advantage of the killing of two of its nationals by natives of Leizhou in Guangdong, occupied Guangzhou Bay with warships and came to negotiate a lease, declaring it a place for anchoring ships and storing coal that would not impair Chinese sovereignty; yet the leased area straddled the two prefectures of Gaozhou and Leizhou, reaching inland from the coast, and the islands of Donghai, Naozhou, and other places obtained, along with Chikan, Zhi Man, Xinxu, and other sites, were all incorporated into the leased territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, after two French nationals were killed by men from Leizhou in Guangdong, France sent warships to seize Guangzhou Bay and opened lease negotiations, claiming the bay was only for anchorage and coal storage and would not touch Chinese sovereignty; the leased zone nonetheless sprawled across Gaozhou and Leizhou prefectures from the coast inland, bringing Donghai and Naozhou islands and places such as Chikan, Zhi Man, and Xinxu into the concession.

sentences.zh: 又得吳川之半島及通明港。

translations.literal: They also obtained the peninsula of Wuchuan and Tongming Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: The lease also took in the Wuchuan peninsula and Tongming Harbor.

sentences.zh: 是年，又以兵強佔上海、寧波四明公所義地，寧人罷巿，幾激變。

translations.literal: That same year, troops again forcibly occupied the burial grounds of the Siming Guild Hall in Shanghai and Ningbo; the people of Ningbo closed the markets, and a riot nearly erupted.
translations.idiomatic: That year French troops also seized by force the burial grounds of the Siming guild halls in Shanghai and Ningbo; Ningbo merchants shut down the markets and unrest nearly broke out.

sentences.zh: 久之始定。

translations.literal: Only after a long time was the matter settled.
translations.idiomatic: It took some time before calm returned.

sentences.zh: 時廣西永安有殺斃法教民之事，方議辦犯、劾官、賠償、建堂四條，適值北海鐵路造至南寧，援龍州鐵路案，中、法合辦，法使遂要求將鐵路歸併教案。

translations.literal: At the time in Yong'an, Guangxi, there was an incident in which French converts were killed; China was just discussing four provisions—punishing the offenders, impeaching officials, paying indemnity, and building churches—when the Beihai railway construction reached Nanning; citing the Longzhou railway case in which China and France jointly managed it, the French minister then demanded that the railway be merged into the missionary-case settlement.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile in Yong'an, Guangxi, French converts had been killed, and talks were underway on four points: punishing the culprits, disciplining officials, paying compensation, and erecting churches. When Beihai railway construction reached Nanning, France cited the precedent of the jointly run Longzhou railway and demanded that the railway issue be folded into the missionary-case settlement.

sentences.zh: 議久始允就案議結，不及他事。

translations.literal: After long negotiation, China at last agreed to settle only the case at hand and not extend to other matters.
translations.idiomatic: After prolonged debate China agreed to settle the case alone, without conceding anything else.

sentences.zh: 又施南、宜昌、長沙均因教堂、教民啟釁未結。

translations.literal: Moreover, at Shinan, Yichang, and Changsha disputes arising from churches and converts remained unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: Disputes over churches and converts at Shinan, Yichang, and Changsha also remained open.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春，拳匪亂，法人調兵與德、英、俄、美、日本聯軍入京，復督兵西進至廣昌，屢阻之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year, when the Boxer turmoil broke out, the French mobilized troops to enter Beijing with the allied armies of Germany, Britain, Russia, America, and Japan, and again directed troops westward as far as Guangchang; they were repeatedly blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-sixth year, during the Boxer uprising, France sent troops into Beijing with the German, British, Russian, American, and Japanese allies, and again pushed forces west as far as Guangchang, where they met repeated resistance.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，展漢口租界。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the Hankou concession was expanded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year the Hankou concession was enlarged.

sentences.zh: 是年法遣鮑渥為駐華公使。

translations.literal: That year France sent Beaux to serve as minister to China.
translations.idiomatic: That year France dispatched Beaux as minister to China.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，外務部與法隆興公司總辦彌樂石訂雲南礦務章程。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs concluded mining regulations for Yunnan with Milleson, general manager of the French Longxing Company.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year the Ministry of Foreign Affairs signed Yunnan mining regulations with Milleson of the French Longxing Company.

sentences.zh: 先是彌樂石到滇，與礦務大臣唐炯議欲設中西礦務公司，唐炯入告，奉旨交雲貴總督魏光燾等與彌樂石議，曆七閱月始竣。

translations.literal: Earlier Milleson had come to Yunnan and discussed with mining commissioner Tang Jiong the establishment of a Sino-Western mining company; Tang Jiong reported to the throne, and an imperial decree ordered Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general Wei Guangtao and others to negotiate with Milleson; seven months passed before negotiations concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Milleson had earlier reached Yunnan and discussed forming a joint Chinese-Western mining company with mining commissioner Tang Jiong; Tang memorialized the court, and an edict assigned governor-general Wei Guangtao of Yunnan-Guizhou to negotiate with him—a process that took seven months to finish.

sentences.zh: 乃入奏，略謂：一，初議限制中國公司延聘礦師，貸用洋款，後亦不入別國洋股，專用英、法礦師，定議；

translations.literal: He then memorialized the throne, stating in summary: first, the initial proposal to restrict Chinese companies in hiring foreign mining engineers and borrowing foreign capital, and later also not admitting foreign shares from other countries, using exclusively British and French engineers—this was agreed;
translations.idiomatic: In his memorial he summarized the terms: first, on the original limits on Chinese companies hiring foreign mining engineers and borrowing foreign capital—and on excluding other nations' capital while employing only British and French engineers—agreement was reached;

sentences.zh: 一，運礦自修鐵路，接通滇越幹路，訂明俟幹路成時再議，並禁售票搭載客貨，預存限制；

translations.literal: second, on building railways for ore transport connecting to the Yunnan-Vietnam trunk line, it was stipulated that this would be discussed again when the trunk line was completed, and that selling tickets to carry passengers and goods was forbidden, with restrictions reserved in advance;
translations.idiomatic: second, on ore-hauling railways linking to the Yunnan-Vietnam main line, it was agreed to revisit the matter once the trunk line was built, with prior restrictions including a ban on selling tickets for passengers or freight;

sentences.zh: 一，公司收買山地，按民間租價，公平租賃，地由滇官指交，價由公司照給，逾限三年不辦，原地歸還業主；

translations.literal: third, on company purchase of hill lands, at fair lease according to local rent prices—the land to be handed over as designated by Yunnan officials, the price paid by the company, and if work did not proceed within three years, the original land to revert to the owners;
translations.idiomatic: third, hill lands were to be acquired at fair rents set by local rates, with Yunnan officials designating parcels and the company paying; land unused after three years would revert to the owners;

sentences.zh: 一，完納礦稅，議定按出井出爐礦質，每百抽五，抵納稅課，並派員分礦監收。

translations.literal: fourth, on payment of mining tax, it was agreed that on ore taken from mines and smelters a levy of five per hundred would be applied in lieu of tax duties, and officials would be dispatched to supervise collection at each mine;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, mining tax was set at five percent of ore raised from shafts and furnaces, paid in lieu of other duties, with officials assigned to collect at each site;

sentences.zh: 適彌樂石由滇入京，向外務部催訂合同，外務部告以礦地未定，未便先議章程，並不准攬辦全省。

translations.literal: Just then Milleson entered the capital from Yunnan and pressed the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to conclude a contract; the ministry replied that mining districts were not yet fixed and regulations could not be discussed first, and that running the whole province was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: When Milleson arrived in Beijing from Yunnan and pressed for a contract, the ministry said the mining districts were unsettled and refused to finalize regulations in advance—or to grant a province-wide monopoly.

sentences.zh: 彌樂石允指澂江、臨安、開化、雲南、楚雄等府及元江州、永北廳凡七處，載入章程第一款內，將原議「嗣後別國公司概不准來滇辦礦」，改為「嗣後別國公司概不准在公司所指之地勘采」，以清界限。

translations.literal: Milleson agreed to designate seven places—Chengjiang, Lin'an, Kaihua, Yunnan, and Chuxiong prefectures and Yuanjiang subprefecture and Yongbei department—and have them entered in Article One of the regulations, changing the original stipulation "hereafter no foreign company from another country shall be permitted to mine in Yunnan" to "hereafter no foreign company from another country shall be permitted to survey and mine in the places designated by the company," to clarify boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: Milleson agreed to limit operations to seven districts—Chengjiang, Lin'an, Kaihua, Yunnan, Chuxiong, Yuanjiang, and Yongbei—listed in Article One, changing the original stipulation "hereafter no foreign company from another country shall be permitted to mine in Yunnan" to "hereafter no foreign company from another country shall be permitted to survey and mine only in the places designated by the company," to clarify boundaries.

sentences.zh: 彌樂石以原議包辦全省礦利，故原歲給京銅一百五十萬斤，並津貼員弁兵勇護廠銀二萬兩。

translations.literal: Milleson noted that because the original plan had covered mining profits for the whole province, the original provision was an annual tribute to the capital of 1,500,000 jin of copper, plus an allowance of 20,000 taels of silver for officers, soldiers, and guards protecting the works.
translations.idiomatic: Because the original scheme had covered all Yunnan's mining, it had called for 1,500,000 jin of copper yearly to Beijing plus 20,000 taels for guards and troops.

sentences.zh: 今既改為七處，應請減議定繳京銅一百萬斤。

translations.literal: Now that it had been changed to seven places, the annual copper tribute to the capital should be reduced by agreement to 1,000,000 jin.
translations.idiomatic: With only seven districts in play, the annual copper tribute was reduced to 1,000,000 jin.

sentences.zh: 護廠費由公司給發，不拘定數。

translations.literal: Expenses for guarding the works were to be paid by the company, without a fixed amount.
translations.idiomatic: Guard costs would be borne by the company without a fixed cap.

sentences.zh: 招募土勇，改為稟請地方官招募，遴選武官一員管帶。

translations.literal: Recruiting local militia was changed to petitioning local officials for recruitment, with one military officer selected to command them.
translations.idiomatic: Local militia would be recruited through local officials, under a selected military officer.

sentences.zh: 遂定議。

translations.literal: The terms were thus agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Agreement was reached.

sentences.zh: 惟第一款內載有「公司尋出之金、銀、煤、鐵、五金、白銅、錫及火油、寶石、硃沙礦，允給公司承辦」等語，滇督魏光燾以礦類白金、白銅、錫三項為原章所無，因咨外務部，請照滇中前定原章，照會英、法公使，轉令彌樂石仍將三項刪除。

translations.literal: However, Article One contained language such as "gold, silver, coal, iron, the five metals, white copper, tin, and petroleum, gems, and cinnabar mines discovered by the company are permitted to be operated by the company"; Yunnan governor Wei Guangtao held that platinum, white copper, and tin were not in the original regulations, and therefore consulted the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, requesting that in accordance with the original Yunnan regulations, notes be sent to the British and French ministers to instruct Milleson to delete the three items.
translations.idiomatic: Article One, however, contained language such as "gold, silver, coal, iron, mixed metals, white copper, tin, petroleum, gems, and cinnabar mines discovered by the company may be operated by the company"; Governor Wei Guangtao noted that platinum, white copper, and tin had not appeared in the original Yunnan terms and asked the ministry to notify the British and French ministers to have Milleson strike those three categories.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，總理外務部慶親王奕劻與法使呂班訂滇越鐵路條約三十四條：:一，鐵路自河口抵蒙自，或由蒙自附近至雲南省城，日後擬改，須彼此商准；

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Prince Qing Yikuang, chief minister of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, concluded with French minister Beau the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway Treaty of thirty-four articles: first, the railway from Hekou to Mengzi, or from near Mengzi to Yunnan provincial capital—if the route were later changed, mutual consent would be required;
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Prince Qing Yikuang, head of foreign affairs, and French minister Beau signed the thirty-four-article Yunnan-Vietnam Railway Treaty: Article 1—the line would run from Hekou to Mengzi, or from near Mengzi to the Yunnan capital; any later route change would require mutual consent.

sentences.zh: :二至四，勘路繪圖及交地購地各事；

translations.literal: Articles two through four: route survey and mapping, land handover and purchase, and related matters;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 2 through 4 covered route survey and mapping, land handover and purchase, and related matters;

sentences.zh: :五，各項廠棧同時開工；

translations.literal: Article five: all workshops and depots to begin construction simultaneously;
translations.idiomatic: Article 5 required all workshops and depots to begin construction at the same time;

sentences.zh: :六，鐵軌寬一邁當；

translations.literal: Article six: track gauge of one meter;
translations.idiomatic: Article 6 fixed the track gauge at one meter;

sentences.zh: :七，鐵路經過地方，不得損壞城垣公署；

translations.literal: Article seven: the railway must not damage city walls or government offices along its route;
translations.idiomatic: Article 7 forbade damage to city walls or government offices along the route;

sentences.zh: :八、九，購料及挖取沙石、採伐林木各事；

translations.literal: Articles eight and nine: procurement of materials, excavation of sand and stone, and felling of timber;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 8 and 9 covered procurement of materials, excavation of sand and stone, and felling of timber;

sentences.zh: :十，運路及暫時興工各地，用竣後即交還；

translations.literal: Article ten: haul roads and temporary construction sites to be returned when work was finished;
translations.idiomatic: Article 10 required haul roads and temporary construction sites to be returned once work was complete;

sentences.zh: :十一，幹路造成，商接支路；

translations.literal: Article eleven: after the trunk line was built, branch lines might be negotiated;
translations.idiomatic: Article 11 allowed branch lines to be negotiated after the trunk line was completed;

sentences.zh: :十二，各執事凡須專門學者，可用外國人；

translations.literal: Article twelve: posts requiring specialists could be filled by foreigners;
translations.idiomatic: Article 12 permitted foreigners to fill posts requiring specialized training;

sentences.zh: :十三、四，工匠之招募管理及賞恤傷亡、懲辦犯罪各辦法；

translations.literal: Articles thirteen and fourteen: methods for recruiting and managing laborers, compensating injury and death, and punishing crimes;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 13 and 14 set rules for recruiting and managing laborers, compensating injury and death, and punishing crimes;

sentences.zh: :十五，巡丁可募土民，不得請派西兵；

translations.literal: Article fifteen: patrolmen could be recruited locally; no foreign troops could be requested;
translations.idiomatic: Article 15 allowed local patrolmen to be recruited but barred the dispatch of foreign troops;

sentences.zh: :十六，洋員請給護照事；

translations.literal: Article sixteen: passports for foreign staff;
translations.idiomatic: Article 16 covered passports for foreign staff;

sentences.zh: :十八，租賃房屋事；

translations.literal: Article eighteen: leasing of houses;
translations.idiomatic: Article 18 covered the leasing of houses;

sentences.zh: :十九，不得損及民人產業，有則賠償；

translations.literal: Article nineteen: private property must not be harmed; compensation where damage occurred;
translations.idiomatic: Article 19 forbade harm to private property and required compensation where damage occurred;

sentences.zh: :二十，火藥炸藥之運制及防險；

translations.literal: Article twenty: transport, manufacture, and safety measures for gunpowder and explosives;
translations.idiomatic: Article 20 regulated the transport, manufacture, and safe handling of gunpowder and explosives;

sentences.zh: :二十一、二，運貨納稅、免稅各例；

translations.literal: Articles twenty-one and twenty-two: rules on freight duties and exemptions;
translations.idiomatic: Articles 21 and 22 set rules on freight duties and exemptions;

sentences.zh: :二十三，收費、減費、免費各例；

translations.literal: Article twenty-three: rules on charges, reductions, and exemptions;
translations.idiomatic: Article 23 laid down rules on charges, reductions, and exemptions;

sentences.zh: :二十四，鐵路不准載運交鹽及西國兵械，如中國有戰事，悉聽調度；

translations.literal: Article twenty-four: the railway might not carry contraband salt or foreign arms; in time of war in China it would follow government orders;
translations.idiomatic: Article 24 forbade carrying contraband salt or foreign arms on the line and required the railway to follow government orders in time of war;

sentences.zh: :二十八，設專門學堂；

translations.literal: Article twenty-eight: establishment of specialized schools;
translations.idiomatic: Article 28 provided for specialized schools;

sentences.zh: :二十九，設電線、電話；

translations.literal: Article twenty-nine: installation of telegraph and telephone lines;
translations.idiomatic: Article 29 authorized telegraph and telephone lines;

sentences.zh: :三十一，滇省派員襄助公司；

translations.literal: Article thirty-one: Yunnan would assign officials to assist the company;
translations.idiomatic: Article 31 required Yunnan to assign officials to assist the company;

sentences.zh: :三十二，定公司補償中國查看費，各員來往照料費；

translations.literal: Article thirty-two: the company would pay China's inspection costs and officials' travel expenses;
translations.idiomatic: Article 32 fixed company payment of China's inspection costs and officials' travel expenses;

sentences.zh: :三十四，此路十八年期滿，中國可與法國商議收回。

translations.literal: Article thirty-four: at the end of eighteen years China might negotiate with France to recover the line.
translations.idiomatic: Article 34 allowed China, after eighteen years, to negotiate with France for recovery of the line.

sentences.zh: 是年，法人因吉林教案索賠償。

translations.literal: That year the French demanded compensation over a missionary case in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: That year France demanded compensation over a missionary case in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 三十年秋七月，法使館交還欽天監觀象臺儀器二十八件。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn of the thirtieth year, the French legation returned twenty-eight instruments from the Directorate of Astronomy observatory.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn of the thirtieth year the French legation returned twenty-eight observatory instruments from the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 三十一年春，法商欲自上海至紹興行輪，阻之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirty-first year, French merchants wished to run steamers from Shanghai to Shaoxing; this was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the thirty-first year French merchants sought to run steamers from Shanghai to Shaoxing; China blocked them.

sentences.zh: 是年與各國定值百抽五稅則，法有違言，久之始允。

translations.literal: That year ad valorem five-percent tariff rates were fixed with the various powers; France objected at first but eventually agreed after a long delay.
translations.idiomatic: That year China fixed ad valorem five-percent tariff rates with the foreign powers; France objected at first but eventually agreed after prolonged negotiation.

sentences.zh: 三十二年春正月二十九日，南昌縣知縣江召棠被殺於天主堂。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth day of the first month of spring in the thirty-second year, Jiang Zhaotang, magistrate of Nanchang County, was killed in a Catholic church.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth day of the first month of spring in the thirty-second year, Jiang Zhaotang, magistrate of Nanchang County, was killed in a Catholic church.

sentences.zh: 先是召棠辦教案頗持正。

translations.literal: Earlier Zhaotang had handled missionary cases with marked fairness.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang had earlier handled missionary cases with marked fairness.

sentences.zh: 法教士王安之因上年荏港教案，有二教民鄧貴和、葛洪泰在南昌縣監禁，強請釋放，召棠向索縱囚，其一匿法教堂中，王安之不交，函約召棠會飲，被殺。

translations.literal: French missionary Wang Anzhi, because of the Ren'gang missionary case the previous year, had two converts—Deng Guihe and Ge Hongtai—imprisoned in Nanchang County; he forcibly demanded their release. Zhaotang pressed to recover the prisoners; one was hidden in the French church and Wang Anzhi would not surrender him; he invited Zhaotang by letter to a drinking meeting, where Zhaotang was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Over the previous year's Ren'gang incident, French missionary Wang Anzhi had two converts, Deng Guihe and Ge Hongtai, held in Nanchang jail and demanded their release. Magistrate Jiang pressed for custody of the prisoners; one was hidden in the French church and Wang refused to hand him over. Wang then invited Jiang to a banquet by letter—and killed him there.

sentences.zh: 民情大憤，集眾毀法教堂，傷斃王安之及教習等數名，並波及英教堂，久之始定。

translations.literal: Public wrath ran high; crowds gathered and destroyed French churches, wounding and killing Wang Anzhi and several teachers, and the violence also spread to British churches; only after a long time was order restored.
translations.idiomatic: Fury seized the populace; mobs wrecked French churches and killed Wang Anzhi and several teachers, and violence spilled into British missions before calm slowly returned.

sentences.zh: 法人欲坐召棠自刎，及派兵船來贛責償。

translations.literal: The French sought to maintain that Zhaotang had committed suicide, and dispatched gunboats to Jiangxi to demand compensation.
translations.idiomatic: France insisted Jiang had killed himself and sent gunboats to Jiangxi to demand indemnity.

sentences.zh: 命鄂督張之洞查辦，屢執仵傷單及醫憑單與爭，終徇其請，賠以法銀二十餘萬。

translations.literal: The court ordered Huguang governor-general Zhang Zhidong to investigate; he repeatedly cited the coroner's report and medical certificates in dispute, but in the end yielded to their demands and paid more than 200,000 French silver dollars in compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhidong of Huguang was ordered to investigate; he repeatedly contested France with the coroner's report and medical evidence, but ultimately gave way and paid over 200,000 French silver dollars.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，法遣領事入滇商辦事。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year France sent a consul into Yunnan to handle business affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-third year France sent a consul into Yunnan to handle commercial affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月，蒙自法郵局設代收遞人役，詰之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the French post office at Mengzi set up personnel to collect and deliver mail on behalf of others; China protested.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the French post office at Mengzi began using couriers to collect and deliver mail on others' behalf; China protested.

sentences.zh: 九月，索還法人所占塘沽碼頭。

translations.literal: In the ninth month China demanded the return of the Tianjin wharf occupied by the French.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month China demanded the return of the Tianjin wharf the French had occupied.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，與四國銀行定粵漢川漢鐵路借款合同。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, a loan contract for the Guangzhou-Hankou and Sichuan-Hankou railways was concluded with a consortium of four powers' banks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xuantong, China concluded a loan contract with a four-power banking consortium for the Guangzhou-Hankou and Sichuan-Hankou railways.

sentences.zh: 原借五百五十萬金鎊，五釐行息，專為築造粵漢、川漢兩路，法與英、德、美均與焉。

translations.literal: The original loan was five million five hundred thousand pounds at five percent interest, solely for building the Guangzhou-Hankou and Sichuan-Hankou lines; France participated along with Britain, Germany, and the United States.
translations.idiomatic: The original loan was five million five hundred thousand pounds at five percent interest, solely to build the Guangzhou-Hankou and Sichuan-Hankou lines; France participated along with Britain, Germany, and the United States.
